findings.generic_safeguard: Keep one fixture-tested truth-semantics utility (delivered / scheduled / committed / scorer truth) and forbid reimplementation; new runners must import it. Fixtures must include the degenerate alignment (commit == probe index) and the case where information precedes the commit. A validation anchor counts only if it exercises the edge it is meant to certify.
findings.recurs_later: After G1 (22 Sep) the commit/onset form stopped recurring in this era. The same class of label-semantics mismatch recurs as the 'rel' vs 'relation' branch IDs (T06, 28–29 Sep), the class ID 0–3 vs ASCII 48–51 auditor bug (27 Sep) and the JSON list vs tuple source check (27 Sep).

findings.title: Proxy endpoint replaced the objective: mechanism dispositions decided on blanket old-memory retention; competence only via a mislabeled terminal column (earliest proxy-objective incident in this era)
findings.description: Doc: all 120 OMNIBUS10 factorial contrast rows used endpoint A_keep_after_D_heldout_bpc. Competence existed only as two undocumented means, and revision_accuracy_effect_mean was reconstructed as terminal after_D/A_rev accuracy, not the revision curve. On the true curve the ranking reverses: C_FORGET is the only factor that helps revision, and B_CONSOL hurts it. Claude withdrew its earlier claim that B_CONSOL outranked C_FORGET. CONTRACT_0.05 was the unique arm of ten passing every competence gate and was blocked solely by nine blanket old-memory gates. Raw competence tables (125k prequential rows and more) had been collected and never analysed. The retention-term scanner caught 0/4 V51 exclusion statements. The mechanism ledger was 'reconstructed' by regex matching M\d+ out of connectome neuron IDs. Development evidence had already misled four times (V81E/V82E/V84E/V85E CONFIRMATION_NOT_PASSED). Inference: this is the earliest documented instance in this era of the proxy-for-objective class. The CORE_RECOVERY line that followed (A2–A9, BKR, FB1, Post-V5) scored only taught-fact usefulness (P1–P7, first-use return), i.e. E1, for about a week. The 26 Sep objective contract later named this drift.

findings.generic_safeguard: Every disposition or adoption must name its endpoint and E-level. A mechanism cannot be closed or adopted on one proxy endpoint when competence endpoints exist; re-derive any summary column from raw data before citing it. Ledger and ID mappings must be reconstructed from design documents, never by regex.
findings.recurs_later: Yes. The retrospective (ROUTE_RETROSPECTIVE_20261014 A01) says the contraction to taught-association retention ran 21–26 Sep and recurred after the 26 Sep contract. Regex-over-identifiers recurs in the 23 Oct archive's own era classifier (T19).

findings.title: Selective endpoint display produced a false universal claim ('nothing reaches 5 pp', 'no trade-off')
findings.description: Doc: the b_slow intervention decision showed a five-endpoint extractor shortlist and concluded 'Nothing reaches the threshold... This is a clean null... no compensating decline'. The next decision admits that every cell already saved P1–P7: 'I displayed a five-endpoint extractor shortlist and omitted P2, P3 and P7'. P7 reactivation was +9.64 pp (0/8 blocks negative), and P2/P3 were about −1.07 pp, so 'No trade-off is wrong'. The primary verdict was kept unchanged, which was correct. The same correction list retracts three more statements: a final-state tanh histogram presented as update-weighted, 'conserved alpha means conserved future response', and passive slow decay 'negligible' (actual survival 0.600). Separately, Step 11's prose required an old-end held-out probe but the code did not save it ('execution shortfall'), so Step 12 had to re-run that localization on fresh worlds.

findings.generic_safeguard: Generate report tables from the full saved endpoint schema, never from a hand-picked extractor list. Machine-check any universal sentence ('nothing reaches X', 'no trade-off', 'no harm') against every endpoint and stratum. Add a probe-roster assertion that each endpoint named in the design exists in the receipts before science starts.
findings.recurs_later: The design/code roster mismatch recurs at Step 11 (27 Sep), the A7 missing gamma pre-state and the A2 summary-only pilot (see T09/T23). The retrospective's root cause, that local limitations are lost in summaries, is the same class.

findings.title: Analysis artifacts read as mechanism: A6 pooled-mean decomposition, rank-by-construction and sign-flipped nested-model numbers withdrawn by the A6 audit and A7
findings.description: Doc: the independent A6 audit reproduced the +6.12 pp leave-one-block-out gain but found the memo's explanation ('M carries self signal plus harmful collateral; C is small noise') does not survive K=8. Its findings: (a) A6 pools mu_g over all non-target sources, so source-specific structure moves into the residual as the pool broadens; (b) the linear M transfer matrix is rank-1 by construction, so its low rank 'would not independently establish a biological low-rank collateral mechanism'; (c) participation ranks came from only eight block vectors; (d) the quoted nested-model values 5.738/... have the sign of native minus subtracted, i.e. they are not centering gains; (e) the emphasized K=2 example differs fundamentally from K=8; (f) the proposed Rayleigh objective rewards wrong-sign self effects and needs inaccessible foreign readouts. A7 then showed the source-specific P carries +6.99 self margin versus +0.34 for the residual. Its Chinese summary: the A6 strong explanation 'needs to be withdrawn'. The A7 decision states 'Not established: a harmless universal mean'. Inference: the memo built a mechanistic story on quantities whose structure was fixed by the estimator, which is the earliest in-era case of 'tautological evidence'.
evidence: results/58d362442643b7ea_REPORT.md (orig PROJECT_AUDIT_A6_20260920/REPORT.md) §2, §3, 'Two further corrections to the memo'
designs/88153b4b3bf8014d_DESIGN.md (orig WorkstreamA7_source_collateral_20260920/DESIGN.md) refinement 1: never sum individual nonlinear effects
findings.how_detected: Independent audit that re-implemented the native expression and enumerated folds (not reusing the runner shortcut), followed by an A7 diagnostic varying the pooling construction.
findings.generic_safeguard: Before interpreting any decomposition, rank, spectrum, Shapley split or 'variant' score, compute what it equals by construction: a null or shuffled input, the rank bound implied by the estimator, and the effect of the pooling choice. Vary the construction (source-specific vs pooled vs leave-out) and require the interpretation to survive. Record the sign convention next to every reported number.
findings.recurs_later: Same class: the A11 128-d Rademacher sketch that caps participation ratio at 128 (21 Sep, T05); E2 passes guaranteed by built-in invariance (27 Sep, T16); rank-family transfer explainable by a scalar potential (V9.10A–D).

findings.title: Diagnostic 'upper bounds' that were not upper bounds led to a wrong design conclusion
findings.description: Doc: FLYROUTE (25 Sep) concluded from an L-BFGS decoder (λ=1e-4, 500 iterations) that 'Even the ideal readout stays below the gate's 0.65. Fixing the learning rule alone would not be enough.' Iteration 2 noticed that the pre-specified decoder scored below the online readout of the same KCs (0.48 vs 0.71–0.74), 'so it cannot be an upper bound'. Refitting gave 0.927–0.982 for LAT4 and 0.684 for FE0, and iteration 1's statement was formally corrected. In the A11 audit (21 Sep), a 128-d Rademacher sketch with participation ratio computed after projection forces rank ≤128 'and three seeds agreeing only proves stability'. The learned-h bridge (27 Sep) had near-perfect E0 linear decodability (99–100%) yet failed behaviour (E1 73.0%, spacing E2 35.5%). Inference: 'ideal readout', 'decodability' and 'code distance' proxies were repeatedly used as bounds on what learning could achieve without checking that they dominate observed learners.

findings.generic_safeguard: Any estimator labelled oracle, upper bound or ideal readout must be shown ≥ every learner evaluated on the same data and be validated on known high-rank and known-solvable fixtures. Report its regularization sweep. Never use E0 decodability or KC separation as a pass gate for behaviour.
findings.recurs_later: Geometry proxies kept being proposed and rejected. Output Step 4 rejects Claude's 'minimum KC distance above 44' gate; Steps 5/6 show larger KC separation did not yield value learning; Step 8 finds 72.7% code-nearest access but 0.097 margin correlation.

findings.title: Causal control silently non-functional ('rel' vs 'relation' branch ID): three-mechanism E3 contrasts and 832 Package B receipts invalid; zero-width intervals published as results
findings.description: Doc: the THREE_MECHANISM_ROUND report published 'R2 vs R0 ... +0.0 [−7.3, +7.3]; Z1 vs Z0 +0.0 [+0.0, +0.0]; T2 vs T0_2 +0.0 [+0.0, +0.0]' and decided integrated improvement NO for all three. My extraction from its SUMMARY.json: for every arm except Rrand, heldout_final_W equals heldout_final_N_old_rel exactly (R0 0.53125/0.53125, Z0 0.75/0.75, T0_2 0.7135/0.7135), so the 'no-old-relation-write' branch was identical to W. The R2/Z1 correction design: 'selected after the earlier three-mechanism run was found to have a nonfunctional N_old_rel control'. The MUSE V3 protocol notice gives the cause: common_platform.branch_allows 'compared rel with relation'. Its E3 contrasts are invalid, and the same source was shipped to the remote packages. CLAUDE_RECOVERY.md (outside archive): Claude Package B's 832 committed receipts had N_old_rel.old_relation=288, equal to W, and 'aggregate totals alone could conceal a wrong write compensated by a missing write elsewhere'. With a working control, Z1−Z0 = −14.6 pp [−27.3, −1.9]. Related vacuous controls in-era: Output Step 2's 'M' wrong-metadata branch was built only after the training loop (post-audit clarification); the Post-V5 readiness review warns that bank-number permutation could be a no-op; and V82E g_pnkc_rewire only permutes CSR B.data, not B.indices, so it never changes partners (A11 review; BYTE_CORE_2 v1). Inference: one string mismatch consumed a full round of science, and the report's [0,0] intervals were the visible symptom, but no zero-variance or W==N tripwire fired. Additional unflagged anomaly (inference): in the correction SUMMARY, Z0 held-out W 85.4% exceeds its taught-relation W 63.3%. The three-mechanism Z family's old-fact accuracy was 0.35 at old end with four outputs (chance 0.25), i.e. weak positive controls. Neither report discusses this.
evidence: results/994af59f25e9acb0_REPORT.md and results/8a273ad2e4713182_SUMMARY.json (orig MINIFLY_R2_Z1_E3_CORRECTION_V1_1_20260929/results/; era EARLY) corrected contrasts
results/f462d4a931733d73_REPORT.md (orig reviews/post_v5_full_v3_readiness_20260921/REPORT.md; era EARLY) 'bank 编号置换可能是空操作'
findings.how_detected: Post-hoc review of the three-mechanism receipts (identical W/N ledgers). The Package A/B handoff review confirmed the cause; the earlier cases were found by design audits and a post-audit code reading.
findings.generic_safeguard: Before science, check a literal per-branch write matrix taken from an independent table, not the runner helper, against a full technical life. Run a mutation test that restores the defect and must fail. Record per-record write bitmaps, not aggregates. Treat any primary contrast whose two arms are bit-identical, or whose variance is exactly zero, as INSTRUMENT_FAILURE, never a null. A parameter or hook name never certifies its effect; verify the actual adjacency or state change.
findings.recurs_later: The retrospective records the Package A/B no-write defect as an execution-quality issue affecting validity. The literal-matrix gate in causal_branch_gate.py is the institutional fix.

findings.title: Guards and decisions that could not fail: zero-width intervals, floors, materiality larger than the effect, ±38 pp risk bands
findings.description: Doc: (a) BYTE_CORE_1 used materiality δ=0.02 for all contrasts while FULL_151+FE0 earned η=0.0047 in total. D-C returned NO_MATERIAL_STREAM_LOSS (stream minus episode = −0.0047, i.e. the stream arm F151-S-FE0 had η=0.0000) and D-E returned CLOCK_INSENSITIVE. Inference: for FULL_151 these labels were guaranteed by the threshold, not measured. (b) The A11 v2 audit F3: D-return at L4 is probably at floor because passive slow decay is 0.030 at 502 d, so the paired anchor difference is 'uninformative by construction'. (c) FB1 v3.2 advanced FB2/4/8 as resource candidates with STABLE_RISK_UNRESOLVED, using retention-risk Hoeffding half-widths of 38.43/33.28 pp. The v3.1 hostile audit had flagged that §24/§45 let a candidate advance even after confirmed old-memory harm. Inference: this guard could essentially never fail. (d) Bridge Steps 6–8 and the A10 decision follow 'zero empirical variance is unresolved', but four days later the three-mechanism report printed [+0.0, +0.0] as a primary interval (T06). The correction design restates 'A zero empirical variance does not justify a zero-width success interval'. A lesson that existed in designs was lost in one round.
evidence: results/0f945a19e8cfb86c_REPORT.md (orig BYTE_CORE_1_20260922/results/REPORT.md) D-C, D-E JSON and milestone rows F151-S-FE0/F151-E-FE0
results/54447ca4d9ccf5c1_REPORT.md (orig CORE_RECOVERY_FB1/v3_2/results/REPORT.md; era EARLY) 保留风险 半宽38.43/33.28
results/80b26b0a1f1af627_DECISION.md (orig CORE_RECOVERY_A10/v2/DECISION.md; era EARLY) 'zero empirical variance; unresolved without invariant'
findings.how_detected: Hostile audits (A11 v2, FB1 v3.1) caught some in advance. Others are visible only on reading the reports; the BYTE_CORE_1 and FB1 points are my inference from the published numbers.
findings.generic_safeguard: Run a sensitivity pre-check per gate and per guard: the minimum detectable effect, the expected half-width at the planned n, and floor/ceiling predictions from known constants. A guard that cannot fail at planned precision cannot license advancement and must be labelled 'not assessable'. Scale materiality thresholds to the arm's own effect size. Any zero-variance, zero-width or exactly-equal-arm result routes to an instrument check.
findings.recurs_later: The zero-variance lesson was lost on 28 Sep and re-institutionalized in the MUSE protocol (Hoeffding interval for zero variance). Insensitive guards recur as the retrospective's 'technical qualification is not behavioural benefit'.

findings.title: Small harness, type and naming errors that silently disabled checks or forced reruns
findings.description:
Doc examples, in date order:
- A2: two pilot instances wrote concurrently into one output directory.
- A2 fresh-world script: inherited copies were renamed, so rglob matched nothing and the exclusion set was 'silently empty'. A guard was added ('aborts if inherited worlds contribute zero cues').
- A2 observer: probe population was inferred from width (len(roles)>=48), so 'final' clipping read the untrained diagnostic probe; explicit population IDs were added.
- A2: SHA256SUMS hashed itself.
- A9: the probe observer did not forward 'lesion'; npz(p, **arrays) clashed with an array named p, so 144 E3 receipts were quarantined and 576 trajectories rerun.
- BKR v5: packed sparse-row checksum bug.
- Post-V5: report failed for lack of matplotlib, and the extra audit missed that dependency.
- Bridge Step 1 v1: JSON list compared with a Python tuple, a false source-check failure.
- BYTE→FULL151 bridge: predictor_total_variation used the intact distribution in both arms (erratum).
- Visible-context bridge: the auditor compared class IDs 0–3 with ASCII 48–51 (AUDIT_ERRATUM).
- Persistence finalizer: numpy.bool_ not JSON-serializable.
- R2/Z1 correction v1: missing nested directory meant zero receipts committed; the analysis then failed on 'lock' not in scope.
Positive: all were disclosed, failed attempts quarantined, no outcomes changed. Inference: the common cause is identity or type inferred implicitly (by width, filename, string spelling, numeric type) rather than asserted. Most were caught only because a downstream check happened to look.
evidence: results/9f4cef7ec335306e_REPORT.md (orig CORE_RECOVERY_POST_V5_FULL_V3/results/REPORT.md; era EARLY) 报告恢复记录
findings.how_detected: Mostly by the agent's own downstream checks: interleaved partial lives, a zero-count, a schema mismatch, a serialization exception, or independent audit logic.
findings.generic_safeguard: Every check gets a fixture that must make it fail. Assert nonzero cardinalities for exclusion sets and populations, and use explicit identity fields instead of inference by size or name. Normalize types before comparisons. Run the complete pipeline, including report rendering, serialization and atomic commit paths, end to end on a technical world before science. Use one output-directory lock per run.
findings.recurs_later: Continuous through 29 Sep. The 'rel' vs 'relation' defect (T06) is the costliest member. The retrospective classes these as execution-quality issues.

findings.title: Clone/snapshot/capture paths silently dropped new state components
findings.description:
Doc examples:
- A2 (19 Sep): codes are encoded once per life, so any input-side B intervention 'may never reach the input representation'. Logged as a contract check (audit D11).
- A7 (20 Sep): the first observation pass omitted gamma-fast pre-state, requiring 24 supplementary replays.
- A9 receipts kept only terminal hashes for gamma/adapt/fast, so 'need a controlled recapture... cannot use these hashes as recoverable checkpoints' (A9 tournament audit).
- Step 11 (27 Sep): 'The inherited V9.2 snapshot/restore and V9.8 query reconstruct FE0 and would silently erase the new front end'.
- W4 bridge routing: NativeActionCreditAdapter.clone was shallow and left the bridged FE owner pointing at the original object.
- FE1 (28 Sep): old snapshot/state_digest assume FE0, and reset_stream() hard-constructs FE0, so an FE1 'retention' could be a technical artifact.
Inference: each new state component (eligibility trace, front-end trace, habituation h, bank) re-exposed the same hazard. A shared state-schema registry did not exist.
evidence: designs/952684c60528ca20_DESIGN.md (orig W4_BRIDGE_ROUTING_20260927/DESIGN.md) 'Do not use W4's NativeActionCreditAdapter.clone'
findings.how_detected: Mostly anticipated by the designer reading the source before running. A7 was caught by a completeness audit after the first pass.
findings.generic_safeguard: Keep a declared state schema per learner. Clone, digest, serialize, restore and reset must iterate that schema, never a hard-coded type. Tests: mutate each new component, then check that the digest changes, clones are independent, restore round-trips, and reset does not revert the component's type. Persist enough per-checkpoint state to recompute every planned diagnostic.
findings.recurs_later: It recurs whenever a component is added (20 Sep, 27 Sep, 28 Sep). The retrospective's A03/A08 (names kept while the mechanism changed) is the later, larger form.

findings.title: Statistical unit and estimator mislabeling; sample size derived from a broken endpoint
findings.description: Doc: A2 presented a delete-one-world jackknife 'as a world-aware standard error' in a multi-membership design. It was relabelled a 'sensitivity spread'. The 8/9 overlap figure was plan-level and overstated every contrast's dependence. The confirmation_n=64 plan came from the fixed-budget k=8 revision SD on the broken denominator; the corrected SD is 4.289 pp, so the required n is 14 (n final 24). A hand-rolled incomplete beta was 'wrong by up to 4× at df=15', and the code now refuses to approximate. Selectivity v2 corrects '48 windows × 8 blocks' to 48 windows in total. Positive counter-examples: V9.4 disclosed boundary sensitivity (leave-one-world-out crosses zero; sign-flip p=0.051) and 'one fixed fly/model seed so intervals do not represent variation across flies'. The A6 audit notes eight positive folds with overlapping donors are not eight confirmations.
evidence: results/618535acd0e9de8e_V2_DECISION.md (orig CORE_RECOVERY_workstreamA2/selectivity_v2/V2_DECISION.md) 'The report wording ... was also wrong'
findings.how_detected: External statistical audit (A2). Self-checks otherwise.
findings.generic_safeguard: Every design names the estimand, the inferential unit (world, block or seed) and any multi-membership structure. Label sensitivity analyses as such. Tie sample-size derivations to the hash of the endpoint definition, so a later endpoint fix invalidates the plan automatically. Use only vetted distribution libraries. Report leave-one-unit-out robustness and the model-seed scope.
findings.recurs_later: This lesson largely stuck. From 20 Sep on, essentially every design states 'the world is the unit; facts, checkpoints and probes are repeated measurements'.

findings.title: Sign, scale and direction errors in objectives, predicates and mechanism descriptions
findings.description:
Doc examples:
- The A2 gap predicate used abs(actual)>=1 instead of the signed predicate, giving 261 vs 8 'access failures' (about 33× inflation) that would have manufactured an access-failure signature.
- The selectivity oracle objective subtracted the protection term, rewarding coordinates that damage protected facts (−39 decisions). Caught before reporting.
- The v1 surrogate used 0.99999756 instead of exp(−dt/τs)−exp(−dt/τf)=0.00884545, 113.1× off. --resume was parsed and never read.
- The b_slow knob was described as 'graded negative feedback'. In fact 67% of coordinates sit where it is inert and 30% are tanh-saturated.
- The Post-V5 review found an algebra error: a nonnegative B-correct/candidate-wrong cost minus a constant-zero baseline.
- The A6 memo's nested-model numbers carried the opposite sign (T04).
- W4 (26 Sep): native error events suppressed the selected answer in only 27/32 cases and favoured it in 5/32 ('credit sign is not robust').
Inference: direction-of-effect was rarely unit-tested on hand-built cases where the correct sign is known.
evidence: results/c12f349d57bbe2e0_WRITE_SELECTIVITY_REPORT.md (orig CORE_RECOVERY_workstreamA2/selectivity/WRITE_SELECTIVITY_REPORT.md) 'A sign error in my own objective'
findings.how_detected: Self-check before reporting (selectivity sign), external audits (A2, selectivity v1, Post-V5), and a post-implementation diagnostic (W4).
findings.generic_safeguard: For every objective, predicate, credit rule and surrogate, write a hand-built fixture where the correct sign and magnitude are known: a damaging write must be penalized, a correct event must strengthen the chosen output, and the surrogate coefficient must equal the closed form. Run it before any science. Describe mechanisms from measured, update-weighted statistics, not final-state histograms.
findings.recurs_later: W4's punishment-direction defect (26 Sep) is the same class at the level of credit assignment. It blocked the arithmetic evolution plan.

findings.title: Pilot/winner's-curse and post-hoc selection: pilot-chosen candidates and evolved winners did not replicate
findings.description: Doc: Step 1 pilot (8 worlds) selected bridge gain 0.05 because it 'restored' taught learning with an apparent held-out advantage. The fresh 128-world Step 2 conjunctive gate failed (D_T lower −6.31 vs −5 required), and 'The pilot's apparent held-out gain advantage did not replicate'. BYTE_ARITH V2: 1,024×128 evolution, 325 family extinctions, and the selected learners scored worse after learning than their own no-write arms (1.3% vs 7.7%). The program audit: 'V2 failed by selecting on noise'; binomial SD about 3 points at 2 lives × 64 questions. The stage exit computed FE0+0.02×CONTENT post hoc on saved values (66.1% held-out) and explicitly refused to count it. FB1 follow-up module A is 'a fixed test set extension proposed after seeing old results, cannot be called independent confirmation'. Positive: after S_FIXED (the control) beat S_LOCAL by 19.05 pp on 48 worlds, it was carried forward only as a new FB1 candidate tested on 224 fresh worlds.
evidence: results/9b9736c166bf5550_REPORT.md (orig BYTE_ARITH_WARMUP_PREFLIGHT_20260926/REPORT.md) 'What the completed evolution actually found'
findings.how_detected: Prespecified fresh-world confirmation gates and a program-level hostile audit.
findings.generic_safeguard: Keep pilot and confirmation rosters disjoint; a pilot-selected parameter is a hypothesis with a shrunken prior. Before any evolutionary search, show that fitness is repeatable (positive correlation between independent lives of the same genome) and that some learner, even a privileged one, can reach the gate at the planned example budget. Label post-hoc weights and test-set extensions exploratory, and never use them as baselines.
findings.recurs_later: The evolution and search temptation recurs in later arithmetic lines (retrospective A05/A08). The stage exit codifies 'no automatic small diagnostic, no infinite weight search'.

findings.title: Engineered components versus native-core attribution: byte 'reading', bridge access and output successes came from added machinery
findings.description:
Doc examples:
- V9.2 passes the narrow byte gate with an engineered 1–4-byte hashed predictor: 2,884,608 mutable bytes, about 17.4× the inherited state. 'removing the native predictive route has no effect because none is wired.' It beats Markov-2 but loses to 8-gram.
- V9.3 shows coexistence only; 'Predictor-off and joint arms had exactly identical native states'.
- The byte→FULL151 bridge passed E0 access (128/128 KC changes), yet behaviour showed BRIDGE_HARM: DiD −21.9 pp [−33.2, −10.6], with taught W 65.1% vs FE0 94.3%.
- The arithmetic W3 design froze 'all Full151 native plasticity in every arm' and trained a new AdamW decoder. The program audit: 'the best achievable deliverable is ... an ML result with no MiniFly attribution'. W4 conceded 'W3 got wrong' the freeze.
- W4's native writer added exactly zero exact answers over its lesion.
- The output steps use four full copies of FULL_151 plus a fixed raw-ASCII teacher decoder ('engineered router').
The reports are candid about all of this. Inference: across this period, engineered branches carried the measured capability, while native FULL_151 contributed mainly the FE0 valence path. Later summaries risk treating the 'byte interface' as solved for the fly.
evidence: results/2fc2e51e9d4e8a29_REPORT.md (orig FULL151_OUTPUT_STEP2_BYTE_TEACHER_20260927/REPORT.md) 'narrow and causal at the engineered router'
findings.how_detected: Prespecified route lesions (V9), W/N and FE0 paired behaviour arms (bridge), and the program hostile audit (arithmetic).
findings.generic_safeguard: Each result carries an attribution ledger: which branch produced the scored answer, a lesion of the native route, the resource ratio against native state, and where teaching labels enter. An E0 access pass never licenses routing a larger learner through the component without a behavioural W/N test.
findings.recurs_later: Yes: retrospective A02 (integration boundary), A03 (native FULL_151 gradually replaced), and A07 (generic IO hash bank is a new memory substrate).

findings.title: Silent objective and constraint drift across consecutive designs (bio front end → NLP → arithmetic evolution → 1+2=3; no-backprop relaxed unflagged)
findings.description: Doc: BYTE_CORE_1 (22 Sep) fixed constraints C1–C8: raw bytes, local learning, no backprop/Transformers, no labels, a fixed decoder, NLMS only as labelled references, biological evidence labels. BYTE_LEARNER v3 (24 Sep): 'anatomical similarity ... are not passing conditions' and engineering parsers/hash sensors allowed. v4: 'sole project goal ... eventually use these bytes on NLP tasks'. Arithmetic V1 (26 Sep): 'The user's current instruction supersedes the attached memo's recommendation to stop mechanism search'. W3 used supervised AdamW backprop through time on revealed answers. The program hostile audit P1.7 'Standing-constraint conflict ... If the owner's earlier constraints (no backprop, no labels, biologically inspired) still apply, W3 violates them'. P0.1: the program 'inverts the order prescribed by MINIFLY_OBJECTIVE_CONTRACT.md' and 'AGENTS.md requires reading V9.9A/B ... the arithmetic line does not engage with those results'. P0.3: the MiniFly route inherited a 1 s byte clock and 128-bin KC pooling, the very losses READ_ORDER had measured the day before. The 26 Sep objective contract was written because of a V88–V9.7 objective-drift audit. Note: that audit document is referenced but absent from both the archive and minifly_b. Inference: the owner authorized some shifts, but nothing tracked which standing constraints remained in force per design. Local lessons (sensor losses) did not carry into the next design line.
findings.how_detected: Program-level hostile audit (Claude, read-only) and the owner-commissioned objective-drift audit that produced the contract.
findings.generic_safeguard: Every design opens with a standing-constraint and objective ledger (C1..Cn, objective statement, contract E-level). Each item is marked RETAINED, RELAXED (with the authorizing owner message) or NEW. A relaxation changes the claim label (for example 'engineered supervised result'). Every design must also list prior measured limitations of each inherited component (sensor, pooling, clock) and how they are addressed.
findings.recurs_later: Yes: retrospective A01 (contraction recurred after the contract), A04 (engineering priors not carried as conditions), A05 (priority drift toward noise handling).

findings.title: Specification gaming caught pre-run: gates passable by a weak countermodel, marginal-vs-joint gates, decorative teacher channel, 'sealed' set used for decisions
findings.description: Doc: the first warmup hostile audit built a countermodel (stored warmup answers, reversed-pair negation, per-operator mode, no arithmetic) that scored 19.0% vs 7.7% zero (+11.2 pp) and passed the proposed Stage-1 gate with each operator above zero. The '128 sealed questions' were also to be used for a design decision (P0), and the V1 and V2 'five-band' grade functions differ (error 16 gives −5 vs −2). The re-audit of W3 found the final gate passable by eight lives each 32/32 on two operators and 0/32 on two (marginal medians, zero lives meeting the joint floor). The cross-entropy update could take answer token IDs directly, so the sensory 'answer stream may be decorative'; a teacher-sensory lesion was required. The anti-mode rule forced 50% or more high-quotient division items against 29.7% in support. Gates sat 3–7× above what fully supervised training reached (program audit). Inference: without these audits the arithmetic line would have rewarded shortcut learners and labelled supervised learning as sensory byte teaching. This is a near-miss of specification gaming, caught by audit practice that worked.
evidence: designs/a53947c45b6c5cb2_MINIFLY_1PLUS2_ALTERNATIVE_DESIGN_20260926.md (orig same) 'public demonstration item' and per-life joint rule
findings.how_detected: Hostile audits that constructed explicit countermodels and score matrices (AUDIT_METRICS.json) rather than arguing in prose.
findings.generic_safeguard: For every promotion gate, implement the cheapest plausible shortcut model (lookup, reversed or canonicalized lookup, per-class mode, partial specialist) and prove the gate rejects it. Make gates joint per independent unit. Before claiming that a channel teaches, lesion that channel while holding labels, timing and optimizer steps fixed. Once a 'sealed' set is used for any decision, it becomes development data.
findings.recurs_later: Institutionalized in the 26 Sep objective contract (recitation countermodel block). From 27 Sep, bridge designs routinely list exact-key, canonical-key and frequency countermodels.

findings.title: E2 (changed presentation) passes guaranteed by the candidate's own built-in invariance
findings.description: Doc: the visible-context CONTENT encoder keys on the last four non-space bytes. Canonical a+b=, the spacing variant and the fixed Q prefix 'all fall on the same four-visible-byte address' and score 512/512. The report and refinement note say E2 here does 'not demonstrate retrieval across changed internal codes'. Input Step 6's fading-pair route skips spaces ('the pair route skips spaces'). Its E2 test changes only whitespace (7 spaces||a||space||+b=), and the report calls it 'the first result ... in which a changed, never-taught presentation ... led the model's own ... memory to emit the taught answer'. H4's PREFIX variant keeps the exact four-byte key; the design pre-declared it ineligible, which was correct. The stage exit closes the bridge on 'narrow E2'. Inference: when the perturbation family lies within the invariance engineered into the candidate, the 'E2' outcome is an E1 measurement. The Input Step 6 headline overstates it, although the body lists the canonicalizer countermodel.
evidence: results/5cc1cbdb55833ac5_REPORT.md (orig FULL151_VISIBLE_CONTEXT_BRIDGE_20260927/REPORT.md) 问题、接口与暴露边界
results/cc02221470451ddf_REPORT.md (orig FULL151_INPUT_STEP6_FADING_PAIR_20260927/REPORT.md) Result paragraph and 'pair route skips spaces'
findings.how_detected: Self-disclosed in the reports and the refinement note, plus the exposure audit required by the objective contract.
findings.generic_safeguard: Before scoring a presentation-change probe, compute the candidate's internal address or code for canonical and variant inputs. If they are identical by construction, the probe is E1. Choose perturbation families independently of the candidate's designed invariances, and include at least one perturbation that changes the effective address.
findings.recurs_later: Retrospective A07: the generic byte IO uses an exact context-hash bank; its successes are taught-sequence E1 and do not inherit E3.

findings.title: Durable unit fact re-derived repeatedly: separated/exact addressing raises E1 recall and abolishes E3 reuse
findings.description:
Doc examples, in date order:
- V9.7 (25 Sep): HASH8 raised taught old choice (96.74% before cohorts) but its own write penalty was −22.1 pp versus −10.9 for REF.
- V9.8: REF transferred on never-reinforced combinations (+27.8 pp immediate), while HASH8 did not (−8.3/−19.4).
- The 50+ mechanism summary (26 Sep) states 'episodic capacity ≠ persistent reusable learning' and 'exact hashing as the entire memory architecture' is closed; only 12/72 renderings shared a HASH8 bank (chance 12.5%).
- Bridge program, 27 Sep: H4 gives perfect E1 (100% vs 54.2%) but shifted-key access of 24.3%. Fading pairs give 90% E1 at 16 facts but held-out W−N −6.25 vs FE0 +21.88 (Step 11), with the deficit present at old end (Step 12). ROLE improves relation but fails capacity (Step 15).
- Assay qualification (28 Sep): CONTENT held-out W−N −1.0 vs FE0 +17.2 pp. The stage exit then states the two capabilities live in different configurations.
Inference: the lesson was available before the bridge program but was not used as a predeclared E3 guard for new address codes. It was rediscovered four times in two days.
findings.how_detected: Paired FE0-versus-candidate held-out contrasts in each experiment, plus the 26 Sep summary.
findings.generic_safeguard: Keep a standing unit-facts register that designs must cite. Any candidate that increases address separation, hashing or exact keying must predeclare an E3 guard against the FE0 baseline on the same worlds, not only E1/E2 endpoints.
findings.recurs_later: Retrospective A07/A02: later engineered banks again excel at taught sequences without E3.

findings.title: 'Supported candidate' status was domain-bound: the B vector did not transfer from the PN world to the byte workload; FB4's advantage was from birth, not protection
findings.description: Doc: A8 LOCAL/B gave +1.75 pp canonical and +6.24 pp K8, and A9 E2/E3 confirmed it (+2.01; +1.83/+5.64 pp; beat four stratified shuffles and GENERIC). It was retained as the 'supported incumbent candidate' through BKR V5. On the byte workload, V9.6 B_TRANSFER old D4 was −1.25 pp [−5.74, +3.24], and delayed cohorts 2 and 3 were 5.8–6.7 pp below REF. FB4 was +7.92 pp, but 'almost all of its old-choice advantage is already present before the four new cohorts'; its write-penalty DiD was +0.42 pp [−6.10, +6.93], with unequal bank occupancy and +20% state. V9.7 likewise found HASH8 absolute gains with a larger own write penalty. Good practice: the reports separate absolute competence from protection (own W−N), which prevented a false 'repair' claim.
evidence: results/f8a26f815ea83f5a_REPORT.md (orig BYTE_CORE_V9_6/REPORT.md; era EARLY) Decision and tables
findings.how_detected: Prospective transfer test on 80 untouched paired worlds with a frozen, unrefitted vector.
findings.generic_safeguard: Adoption records carry the domain and task contract under which a candidate was confirmed. Moving to a new workload requires a fresh transfer test. Always report both the absolute competence difference and the own-write-penalty DiD before calling something protection.
findings.recurs_later: Retrospective A06: the adopted core (COV-SUPPORT) was not the core actually carried into the next round.

findings.title: Archive and catalog meta-error: era classification by version strings splits design/result/correction lineages (same class as the 18 Sep ID-regex error)
findings.description:
Doc: the README says the chronology is 'kept conservative'. In CATALOG.json, the same folders are split across eras:
- BYTE_CORE_V9_5: DESIGN and REPORT are TRANSITION, but REFINEMENT_AUDIT and audit_20260926/AUDIT_REPORT are EARLY_VERSION.
- BYTE_CORE_V9_6: DESIGN is TRANSITION, both REPORTs are EARLY.
- BYTE_CORE_V9_10E: one doc each.
- MUSE copies of V9.9A/B REPORTs are EARLY.
- MINIFLY_R2_Z1_E3_CORRECTION v1 DESIGN is LEGACY, v1.1 DESIGN/REPORT/SUMMARY are EARLY.
- MINIFLY_THREE_MECHANISM_ROUND: DESIGN is TRANSITION, REPORT and SUMMARY are LEGACY.
- CORE_RECOVERY_A10 DECISION, FB1 v3_2 results, FB1 follow-up, A4/A5/A6 DECISIONs, post_v5 and fixed_bank hostile audits (all 20–29 Sep): EARLY.
I counted about 63 non-aggregate documents from 15–30 Sep, or from BYTE_/MINIFLY_/CORE_RECOVERY folders, outside the TRANSITION era. Inference: version tokens such as 'V9', 'v5' or 'v2' match a V1–V49 rule. This mirrors the 18 Sep finding that the scan 'matched M\d+ out of neuron IDs' and that 2,358/2,854 MiniFly files were unclassified. An era-scoped review sees a design without its correction. Example: the in-scope three-mechanism DESIGN, with its invalidating correction outside scope.
evidence: CATALOG.json items for document_id c3a5d145fa3fab4f (REFINEMENT_AUDIT), 6a9f765adc858339 (AUDIT_REPORT), 419b4f3a1bf289f9 vs f8a26f815ea83f5a/af68cc9fa3c5f5f3 (V9_6), 815d1e7dc9bc5fdf and cf1f719a7fca1d9f (three-mechanism results, LEGACY), 3d468db9fadb30c3/5c1f6f539c2b5c6d/994af59f25e9acb0 (R2/Z1 correction)
README.md 'Chronology is kept conservative' bullet list
designs/96139609b9387383_CORE_RECOVERY_REANALYSIS_AND_OPEN_EXPERIMENTS.md §4 A3, A4 (earlier instance of the same class)
findings.how_detected: Cross-checking catalog eras against folder dates and lineage while reading in-scope designs.
findings.generic_safeguard: Classify documents by folder date and lineage graph (design → results → audit → correction/erratum), and keep each lineage together. Run a completeness check that every in-scope design's results and corrections are in scope. Never classify by regex over version tokens. Report counts of split lineages.
findings.recurs_later: Retrospective A10: mechanism IDs mismatched across 108/136/254/71/16-item lists polluted screening understanding. The same class persists in the 23 Oct publication.

findings.title: Implementer-only audit and a validator that accepted impossible values; a post-hoc independent reducer corrected the 'rest recovery' interpretation
findings.description: Doc: the V9.5 refinement audit A3: '"Independent" code review cannot be satisfied. The implementer (Claude) is the only reviewer available ... labelled implementer-audited'. The V9.5 report said the cost 'accumulates ... and a 24 h rest undoes only part of it'. The 26 Sep independent receipt audit confirmed the −11.33 pp result. It also found that the frozen validator 'accepts a choice of 2.0, a NaN scalar margin, and an impossible [99,99,99] overlap label'. And it corrected the rest reading: WWWW old choice did not improve (−0.13 pp); the contrast narrowed because NNNN lost its temporary advantage (−4.69 pp), while the analog write deficit worsened. V9.6 then mandated recomputing choice and margins from canonical pair margins, plus corruption regression tests. Inference: this lesson stuck. From 27 Sep every bridge-step audit rejects deliberate receipt corruptions.
evidence: designs/c3a5d145fa3fab4f_REFINEMENT_AUDIT.md (orig BYTE_CORE_V9_5/REFINEMENT_AUDIT.md; era EARLY) A3, A4, A5
results/6a9f765adc858339_AUDIT_REPORT.md (orig BYTE_CORE_V9_5/audit_20260926/AUDIT_REPORT.md; era EARLY) 'Correction to the rest interpretation' and validator defects
designs/419b4f3a1bf289f9_DESIGN.md (orig BYTE_CORE_V9_6/DESIGN.md) 'Future receipts treat three pair margins ... as canonical'
findings.how_detected: A stand-alone reducer that did not import the learner, plus deliberate synthetic corruptions.
findings.generic_safeguard: Validators must check the ranges and finiteness of every derived field, and derived scores must be recomputed from canonical primitives before aggregation. A narrowing contrast must be decomposed into the two arms' own changes before any 'recovery' language. When no independent reviewer exists, label the run implementer-audited and require a later independent reducer.
findings.recurs_later: Positive: corruption and tamper tests became standard in all 27–29 Sep audits. The analogous 'contrast narrowing misread as recovery' risk recurs in V9.4 (no-write transient benefit), which was decomposed correctly.

findings.title: Store-enough-to-rescore lesson learned at A2 but repeatedly re-encountered (summaries, terminal hashes, aggregate ledgers)
findings.description:
Doc: A2's 'first pilot stored only summaries, so the scoring fix forced a full re-simulation. The pilot now persists checkpoints (216 files) so any future rescoring is offline.' This lesson enabled the 184-cell offline rescore. It was re-encountered several times:
- A6 audit: 'K=2 captures retain aggregate D and group means, but not per-event source rows', leaving a provenance gap until A7 replays.
- A9 receipts keep only final-state hashes for gamma/adapt/fast, so 'need a controlled recapture'.
- FB1 follow-up: common-known retention loss is 'not computable (old per-input bitmaps missing)'.
- FB1 launch gate: full evidence would need about 767 MiB against a 128 MiB cap, so the run did not start.
- CLAUDE_RECOVERY: inherited receipts had aggregate write counts but no per-record write bitmap, which can hide compensating errors.
Inference: storage-minimization targets (<10 MB bundles, 64/256 MiB caps) repeatedly conflicted with the rescoring and audit needs, and the conflict was settled case by case.
findings.how_detected: Each time a later correction or audit needed data that had not been kept.
findings.generic_safeguard: Before locking, enumerate the minimal per-record primitives needed to recompute every endpoint, every tail statistic and every causal-ledger check (pair margins, write decision per record/branch/store, population IDs). Budget storage for them explicitly. Bundles may stay small, but local raw primitives must be kept.
findings.recurs_later: Recurs through 29 Sep. The CLAUDE_RECOVERY per-record bitmap requirement is the latest form.

findings.title: Integration boundary and splicing: separately qualified components are not one learner; stage exit withdrew a post-hoc 'integration' gate but forbade splicing claims
findings.description: Doc: V9.3 showed 'two-head coexistence ... not integration'. CONTENT achieved E1/E2 and 32-key persistence (99.22%, −0.78 pp) in a four-output store architecture, while FE0 achieved E3 (+17.2 pp) with one valence store and an evaluator-supplied two-option comparator. The stage exit decision declares the 'limited engineering bridge' complete, withdraws an earlier suggestion that an integration confirmation was required ('把期望项事后升级为硬门槛，应撤回'), and lists anti-drift rules: no splicing of results from two configurations; the same frozen candidate must pass both E1 safety and delayed E3. Step 12 rejected 'Claude's proposed raw 1:1 parallel-bank sum' as 'not a supposedly ready fix'. Inference: the stage was closed while the project-level E3 objective for the same system remained unproven. The document is explicit, but downstream readers can still conflate 'bridge complete' with 'byte learner works'.
evidence: minifly_b/package/DOCS/BYTE_FULL151_BRIDGE_STAGE_EXIT_DECISION_20260928.md (orig MINIFLY_MUSE_A_V3_CAUSAL_GATE_20260929/DOCS/...) claims table and 防漂移规则
findings.how_detected: Self-review of the claims table during stage exit; consistent W/N contrasts across separate assays.
findings.generic_safeguard: Every stage exit restates three claims separately: component A, component B, and the same system having both. Each carries its own status and an explicit statement of what the next candidate must demonstrate in one frozen configuration. Gates may not be upgraded or downgraded after outcomes without a dated owner decision.
findings.recurs_later: Yes: retrospective A02 lists this as an inheritance boundary later read as an existing whole capability.

findings.title: Host-dependent birth state: FULL_151's PN→KC B re-drawn by a seeded RNG differed across machines (known on 19 Sep, resurfaced for remote packages on 28–29 Sep)
findings.description: Doc: the 19 Sep Workstream A design notes that 'apply_phenotype re-draws B from a whole-genome-seeded RNG, so it must be installed explicitly'. The REMOTE_13 and MUSE shared protocols carry a 'V2 portability rule'. Muse and Claude Code found that a Linux newborn had the prescribed Q digest but a different B digest, because the birth formula combines seeded Gaussian jitter with a numeric exponential. A canonical B NPZ and a birth fingerprint were then mandated. Using each host's raw B as its own baseline was 'not accepted'. Inference: a known reproducibility hazard was not converted into a portable artifact until remote execution exposed it.
findings.how_detected: Remote agents' birth-digest check failed on Linux.
findings.generic_safeguard: Ship model birth states as hashed artifacts (canonical arrays plus a fingerprint), never as RNG recipes. Every runner verifies the birth fingerprint before the first event, and cross-host portability is tested before any multi-host science.
findings.recurs_later: Not observed later in this era; the canonical birth anchor became binding for both packages.

findings.title: Audit practices that worked: recursive pre-run hostile audits, auditors correcting themselves, external proposals treated as hypotheses, explicit NOT_RUN statuses
findings.description:
Doc examples:
- FEAS-1 went through v1 to v6.1 on one day. Each revision lists findings that would have changed what a pass meant: read() side effects giving FE-NI a sampling pulse; a cross-record shortcut; 'not confirmed' turned into 'confirmed absent'; a retention margin allowing a near-zero gain with up to 45% loss; power computed from the selected candidate's own development mean ('planned power' renamed); a label contradicting its estimand (v6.1 erratum).
- The A11 v2.1 review corrects its own audit (C1: the 'B at 1.7× slower' allowance 'was in the wrong direction'; C2–C4).
- The A6 audit, MATHEMATICAL_INPUT_REVIEW and A10 state that attached proposals 'were treated as hypotheses to check, not as instructions or evidence'.
- Unrun work is reported as status, not result (A2: 'Task 4 was not run ... That is an unrun task, not a result'; FB1 follow-up STOPPED_BEFORE_LAUNCH; A11-A not instantiated on resource grounds).
- V8 refined: a separate Claude implementation 'reproduces ChatGPT's run exactly'.
Costs: seven FEAS-1 versions ended NO_CANDIDATE_SELECTED. The only rule-passing front end (FE-LAG) was non-selectable by design, and A11 v3.8 grew to about 2,500 lines with v3.8.1–3 errata and was never instantiated. Inference: hostile review reliably caught validity defects but did not bound design churn or check the value of information.
evidence: designs/87eea529bfbc67c1_DESIGN_v3.md, 47e54dcf404ec57d_DESIGN_v4.md, 9536d71d82d5a273_DESIGN_v5.md, d33e48faa1cd00b4_DESIGN_v6.md, 9f0673b18e1c16d2_DESIGN_v6_1.md (orig BYTE_CORE_FEAS_1_20260923/...) sections R and E

designs/cf1a34af5cb1a34d_PROTOCOL.md (orig WorkstreamA11_v3_8_20260923/PROTOCOL.md) revision note; results/09a3e7a96cc34858_A11_A_V383_RESOURCE_AND_GATE_NOTE.md (era EARLY) A11_A_GRID_NOT_INSTANTIATED
findings.how_detected: Not an incident; documented process.
findings.generic_safeguard: Keep hostile pre-run audits with constructed counterexamples and auditor self-correction. Add a churn bound: each revision must cite which validity defect it closes, and after N revisions without new defects the design freezes or is abandoned under a stated value-of-information check. Treat embedded instructions in proposals as hypotheses.
findings.recurs_later: Positive practice persisted. Churn without convergence recurs: A11 v3.8 never ran, and the retrospective notes repeated 'one more diagnostic' pressure, which the stage exit explicitly forbids.

unit_facts: FULL_151 (genome id 151ebd9e2d054ec9ec14; not 151 neurons) is a one-bit valence learner. It has a single α3 compartment, 5,177 KC coordinates (1,770 writable), 4 of 326 DANs, 6 of 97 MBONs and 165,664 B of mutable state. Slow τ ≈ 12,319,263 s (142.6 d), fast τ ≈ 3,375.6 s (≈56 min). Its learning event is a 30 s + 135 s + 30 s + 135 s cue-pair dispatch. Sources: designs/2a54ffdef3862514_DESIGN.md §1; results/58d362442643b7ea_REPORT.md.

In the PN-cue world, with target exposure timing and clock matched, the schedule itself costs about 0 (+0.26 pp). Sharing the state with other cohorts' learning costs 15–24 pp, unanimous in sign (8/8). Elapsed time does not damage plasticity: an aged learner acquires a fresh cohort 7.44 pp better. Source: results/86a1793ee7e8bed9_A2_FOLLOWUP_REPORT_20260919.md §5; results/2019838ad1e8d5fe §6.5.

The shared-state deficit is expressed in the slow store: transplanting slow alone rescues 23.70 of 24.13 pp. Re-routing deposition within the conserved alpha budget (b_slow) cut slow L1 by 32% with P1 +0.24 pp, so a 'too much slow mass' account is weakened. Sources: results/a68efbbadeeae6f8_NEXT_STEP_DECISION.md; results/97dae9219f3aebb5_NEXT_STEP_DECISION.md.

Write selectivity headroom exists at bout scale (+5.6–6.8 pp protected with incoming noninferior in v2) but not at event scale: one event touches 47/5,177 KCs. The quantity the oracle exploits, other facts' readout sensitivity r_p[i], is not a function of the coordinate's own pre-update state. That is a structural observability gap for local rules. Sources: results/c12f349d57bbe2e0; results/618535acd0e9de8e.

A fixed, label-free local baseline transfer (B, 41,416 fixed bytes) improved PN-world competence: E2 +2.01 pp; E3 +1.83/+5.64 pp. It beat four stratified shuffles and a generic diversion, so exact coordinate correspondence matters. It did not transfer to the byte workload (V9.6: −1.25 pp). Sources: results/481026f1a3aee6f2; results/f8a26f815ea83f5a (era EARLY).

FULL_151 with the fixed FE0 byte front end learns almost nothing on F3 bytes: η = 0.0047, against FE-ID oracle 0.2557 (ρ = 0.018, front end binding). V50-REF reaches η = 0.207 on the same task. FULL_151's per-cue response has a common offset, so its paired choice is the valid readout. Sources: results/0f945a19e8cfb86c_REPORT.md; designs/2a54ffdef3862514 amendment A9.

FE0 keeps the last byte (0.87 decodable at PN) but mostly loses the byte before it (0.22). The native KC expansion improves decodability (a: 0.38 vs 0.22). A latency-class PN organ (LAT4) keeps two-byte order (1.00) and passes the ORDER gate in 3/3 worlds. Sources: results/c69e155a7baa1dcf; results/2fb597f44858e907 (era LEGACY).

Under the causal byte protocol, an FE0 byte-cue association survives 24 h in slow memory (fast decays to ~0). It loses part after 12-pair re-teaching plus 24 h (D3 +0.097 choice) and does not generalize to never-trained pairs (0.495). Re-teaching 12 pairs does not help the other 36. Source: results/b15444ca18867f7d_REPORT.md.

Continued byte learning leaves a persistent old-memory cost under FE0/FULL_151: −11.3 pp after four cohorts (n=256), with no grading by symbol overlap. With an exact four-visible-byte content address the cost at 32 keys is only −0.78 pp [−1.30, −0.26]. Sources: results/802e79d1c8cfe876; results/6d60150e22d8709e.

Exact or separated addressing (HASH8, H4 hash, CONTENT address, fading pairs) raises taught recall (E1) but abolishes held-out relation reuse (E3). FE0's shared code gives a reproducible narrow E3 of about +17 to +24 pp W−N: V9.9A +17.19; Step 10 +21.88 emitted; Step 11 +21.88; Step 12 +23.96; assay qualification +17.2 vs CONTENT −1.0. Sources: listed under T17.

Prior-teaching E3 in the synthetic families is solvable by a one-bit or scalar per-symbol rule. An online NLMS shared KC head reaches 77.5% on rank-family held-out pairs but 51.0% on a cyclic family (scalar ceiling 6/9). That failure is not a span-reachability limit: a held-out-label oracle inside the 37-dim teaching span solves all nine pairs. The missing ingredient is inductive bias, not representation. Sources: results/cfe49b4f76eb5442, results/7237c8e92dc9bcb8, results/79eb1e61f8099fb4.

At equal write dose, the identity of competing cue strings decides whether a taught association survives (0+1= correct 16/16 in panel A vs 1/16 in panel B). Changing only the input front end rescued it. Read-only KC distance thresholds do not predict learned value. Sources: results/162fd85a5ad75dfc; results/cc02221470451ddf; results/e71fbc767bca5b7d.

Using a next-byte prediction distribution as a memory address collapses when all cues share the same following byte: pairwise L1 falls from 0.818 to 0.129 and the W−N write effect from +25 to 0 pp. Stable feature identities (H4) avoid the collapse but are brittle to shifts (24.3% access). Sources: results/22b98b675d8643fa, results/fbf1732a64eb40e9, results/a6918b9812f5b9ac.

Native FULL_151 punishment routed through hashed action contacts lacks reliable direction: an error event favoured the selected answer in 5/32 prefixes. Grade-only REINFORCE with 5-band grades and 128 samples is predicted null. A fully supervised raw-byte GRU with 512 answers is about at constant-zero exact accuracy on unseen one-operator expressions. Sources: results/34316d5e7fb50272; results/26c74d446d907733; results/9b9736c166bf5550.

Within the OMNIBUS10 cell-family layer, the simple homogeneous leaky cell beats static on all 7 competence endpoints. ALIF/ELM proxies are not significantly different, and heterogeneity is worse on all 7. C_FORGET is the only factor that improves revision, and its effect grows with corrective exposures. Source: designs/96139609b9387383 §2.2–2.4.
process_observations: The agent loop in this era usually ran explore → design → hostile audit (often 2–6 rounds) → technical world → pilot on taught cues only → frozen confirmation → independent receipt reducer with deliberate tamper tests. Three bounded test cycles were not a fixed ritual. The functional equivalent was technical world, then pilot, then confirmation, with roster separation strictly respected.

Discipline inside experiments was strong. Failed gates were reported, not relaxed: Step 2 preservation, Step 6 H4 superiority, Step 13/14 per-cue reliability, Step 7 pilot, FE1 θ = −9.64 pp, the BKR arms. Completed trajectories were never rerun. Failed attempts were quarantined (A9 144 receipts, R2/Z1 v1). The weak points were between experiments: lesson carry-over, constraint and objective tracking, lineage.

Corrections were usually written as separate documents (DECISION corrections, ERRATUM files, AMENDMENT.json, post-audit clarification paragraphs, NEXT_PERSISTENCE_REFINEMENT 'Corrections to the proposed interpretation'), and frozen originals were left intact. Some corrections, though, were in-place prose clarifications to REPORT.md (Output Step 2, FE1) without a separate erratum hash.

Multi-agent roles: ChatGPT supplied external scoring and statistical audits in the A2 era. Codex wrote most designs and runners. Claude did re-analysis (CORE_RECOVERY reanalysis), hostile audits (program and A11 audits), an independent re-implementation (V8 refined), and implementer-only runs (V9.5, labelled as such). Several Codex reports explicitly reject Claude proposals: the KC-distance >44 gate, a raw 1:1 parallel-bank sum, and the 17-arm shared FE0 screen. This cross-agent criticism caught real issues.

Several agents recorded 'user instruction supersedes memo recommendation' (arithmetic V1) or framed scope choices as owner decisions (A11 v2.1 C2). When owner wishes and evidence conflicted, the program audit's NO-GO was the corrective. No mechanism existed to check, per design, which earlier owner constraints still applied.

Era scoping of this very review is lossy. Roughly 63 same-period documents, including the decisive R2/Z1 correction, the V9.5 audit, V9.6–V9.10 reports and the FB1 results, sit in EARLY or LEGACY because of version-token matching. Any distillation workflow that partitions by catalog era will miss corrections unless it reconstructs lineage by folder and date.

Documents referenced but absent: V88_TO_V9_7_OBJECTIVE_DRIFT_AUDIT_20260926.md (cited by the objective contract and the retrospective); BYTE_CORE_1_ERRATUM_20260923/ERRATUM.md (only ERRATUM_SUMMARY.json is cataloged); several HOSTILE_AUDIT/SELF_HOSTILE_AUDIT files for BYTE_CORE_2 and BYTE_LEARNER v4; INTERPRETATION_AND_SEARCH_LESSONS.md for FE1. Distilled lessons that depend on them cannot be verified from this archive.

Per-run outputs were optimized for small bundles (<10 MB) and strict disk caps. That repeatedly conflicted with offline rescoring and per-record causal audits (T21), and was resolved ad hoc. FB1 follow-up correctly refused to launch rather than delete evidence.

Statistical framing matured quickly. By 20 Sep nearly every design states the world as the unit and simultaneous Bonferroni families, uses zero-variance-unresolved rules, labels descriptive versus confirmatory results, and uses exact binomial or Hoeffding intervals for degenerate cases. The remaining failure mode was enforcement, as in the three-mechanism [0,0] report.

Value-of-information checking was weak. FEAS-1 needed seven versions, A11 v3.8 grew to about 2,500 lines and was never instantiated, and arithmetic evolution sized gates 3–7× above supervised feasibility. Audits judged validity well and cost or expected information less well, until the program audit's 'minimum conditions to proceed'.

skill_recommendations.name: single-source-truth-semantics
skill_recommendations.rule: All delivered, scheduled, committed and scorer truth, and all exposure-before-probe logic, must come from one imported, fixture-tested utility. New runners and auditors may not re-implement it. Fixtures must include commit == probe index, information preceding commit, and relabelled or renamed sources.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The change_truth commit-vs-onset defect recurred three times in two days in three files (T01). The fix lived in one module and validation used an anchor that passed by coincidence.

skill_recommendations.name: control-actually-differs-gate
skill_recommendations.rule: Before any science world, check each causal branch against a literal expected write/exposure matrix taken from an independent table, not the runner's helper, using a full technical life. Include a mutation test that restores the known-bad behaviour and must fail. Log per-record decisions, not aggregates. Any primary contrast with bit-identical arms or zero variance is INSTRUMENT_FAILURE and must never be reported as a null or a [0,0] interval.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The 'rel' vs 'relation' mismatch disabled N_old_rel for a whole round and 832 Package B receipts. The report printed '+0.0 [+0.0, +0.0]'. Vacuous controls also occurred in Output Step 2 (M built post-training) and in the rewire hook (T06).

skill_recommendations.name: guard-sensitivity-precheck
skill_recommendations.rule: For every gate and guard, compute before science the expected half-width or minimum detectable effect at planned n, floor and ceiling predictions from known constants (decay, chance), and whether the guard can fail. A guard that cannot fail is labelled NOT_ASSESSABLE and cannot license advancement. Materiality thresholds must be smaller than the arm's plausible total effect.
skill_recommendations.rationale: BYTE_CORE_1's δ exceeded FULL_151's whole η, the FB1 retention band was ±38 pp, A11 D-return was at floor by slow τ, and zero-width intervals were published (T07).

skill_recommendations.name: countermodel-per-gate
skill_recommendations.rule: Implement the cheapest plausible shortcut model for each promotion gate: exact or canonicalized lookup, reversed pair, per-class mode, partial specialist, frequency or position. Show that it fails the gate. Gates are joint per independent unit, not marginal medians. To claim a channel teaches, lesion that channel while holding labels, timing and update steps fixed.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Hostile audits showed a lookup+mode countermodel passing +11 pp, specialists passing marginal gates, and a possibly decorative teacher stream (T15). This is the main pre-run defence against specification gaming.

skill_recommendations.name: construction-and-bound-check
skill_recommendations.rule: Before interpreting a decomposition, rank, spectrum, attribution, 'upper bound' or E2 variant, compute its by-construction value: the estimator's rank bound, its value under pooling or shuffling, and whether variant and canonical inputs share the candidate's internal address. Any 'oracle/ideal/upper-bound' must be ≥ every achieved learner on the same data. Otherwise treat it as mis-specified and do not draw conclusions from it.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The A6 rank-1-by-construction and pooling artifacts, the underpowered 'ideal' decoder that produced a wrong design conclusion, the 128-d sketch rank cap, and E2 passes guaranteed by the candidate's own invariance (T04, T05, T16).

skill_recommendations.name: full-endpoint-reporting
skill_recommendations.rule: Generate report tables programmatically from the full saved endpoint schema and machine-check every universal claim ('nothing reaches', 'no trade-off', 'no harm', 'recovers') against all endpoints, strata and both arms' own changes. A narrowing contrast must be decomposed into each arm's change before 'recovery' language is used.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The A2 shortlist omitted P7 (+9.6 pp) behind a false 'clean null' (T03). The V9.5 'rest undoes part of it' was actually the control losing its advantage (T20).

skill_recommendations.name: standing-constraint-and-objective-ledger
skill_recommendations.rule: Every design opens with the objective statement, its E0–E4 contract level, and a ledger of all standing constraints (no backprop, no labels, biological labelling, budget, native-route attribution). Each is marked RETAINED, RELAXED (with dated owner authorization) or NEW. The design must also list measured limitations of each inherited component and how it addresses them. A relaxation changes the claim label.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Objectives drifted from biological front end to NLP to arithmetic to 1+2=3 within six days. W3 relaxed no-backprop without flagging it. The arithmetic line inherited sensor losses measured the day before and ignored mandated prior results (T14). The retrospective confirms recurrence.

skill_recommendations.name: attribution-ledger
skill_recommendations.rule: For every result, record which branch produced the scored answer, a native-route lesion, the resource ratio against native state, and where labels and teachers enter. Results from different configurations may not be combined into one capability claim. A stage exit must list 'component A', 'component B' and 'same system' as separate claims.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Byte reading came from an engineered hashed predictor at 17.4× native state, the bridge's E0 access turned into behavioural harm, and E1 versus E3 were qualified in different architectures (T13, T22).

skill_recommendations.name: state-schema-registry
skill_recommendations.rule: Each learner declares its state components. Clone, digest, serialize, restore and reset iterate the registry. Adding a component requires tests: mutating it changes the digest, clones are independent, restore round-trips, reset does not revert type, and observers capture its pre and post values.
skill_recommendations.rationale: New state was silently dropped or reverted several times: A7 gamma pre-state, Step 11 front-end erasure, W4 shallow clone, FE1 reset_stream, and codes cached once per life (T09).

skill_recommendations.name: rescorable-evidence-budget
skill_recommendations.rule: Before locking, list the minimal per-record primitives (pair margins, per-record/branch/store write decisions, population IDs, per-checkpoint state needed for planned diagnostics). Budget local storage for them separately from the small shared bundle, and refuse to launch rather than drop them.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Summary-only pilots, terminal hashes, missing per-input bitmaps and aggregate-only ledgers repeatedly blocked rescoring or audits (T21).

skill_recommendations.name: unit-facts-register
skill_recommendations.rule: Maintain a cited register of durable unit facts (for example: exact addressing kills E3; the FE0 byte-order limit; FULL_151 is a one-bit valence learner; B is PN-domain-bound; scalar-solvable versus cyclic relations). Every design must cite the relevant entries. A candidate that conflicts with a fact must predeclare the guard that would detect a repeat.
skill_recommendations.rationale: 'Episodic capacity ≠ reusable learning' was known on 26 Sep and re-derived four times on 27–28 Sep. Domain-bound adoption of B was discovered only by failure (T17, T18).

skill_recommendations.name: harness-negative-fixtures
skill_recommendations.rule: Every integrity check ships with a fixture that must make it fail. Assert nonzero cardinalities for exclusion sets and populations. Use explicit identity fields instead of inference by size, filename or string spelling. Normalize types before equality. Dry-run the full pipeline (including report rendering, serialization, atomic commit, directory creation) on a technical world.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Empty exclusion set from renamed files, population inferred by width, JSON list vs tuple, class ID vs ASCII, numpy.bool_, missing directory, out-of-scope variable, missing plotting dependency (T08).

skill_recommendations.name: lineage-preserving-classification
skill_recommendations.rule: When scoping or distilling archives, build the design → results → audit → correction/erratum lineage by folder and date, and keep each lineage within one scope. Never classify by regex over version or ID tokens. Report how many lineages are split and flag referenced but missing documents.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The catalog split V9.5, V9.6, the three-mechanism round and the R2/Z1 correction across eras, repeating the 18 Sep regex-over-IDs error (T19). An era-scoped reviewer would see invalid contrasts without their correction.

skill_recommendations.name: pilot-and-search-feasibility
skill_recommendations.rule: Keep pilot and confirmation rosters disjoint, and treat pilot-chosen parameters as hypotheses to be re-estimated fresh. Before any population or evolutionary search, show that fitness is repeatable across independent lives and that some learner (privileged if necessary) can reach the gate at the planned example budget. Label post-hoc weights and test extensions exploratory.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The Step 1 → Step 2 pilot advantage did not replicate, V2 evolution selected on noise with gates 3–7× above supervised feasibility, and the FE0+0.02×CONTENT weight was chosen post hoc (T12).

skill_recommendations.name: design-churn-bound
skill_recommendations.rule: Each design revision must cite the validity defect it closes. After two consecutive revisions that close no outcome-changing defect, freeze or abandon the design under a written value-of-information statement covering the cost, the decision it informs, and the alternative experiments.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Hostile review caught real defects (T24), but FEAS-1 needed seven same-day versions to reach NO_CANDIDATE_SELECTED, and A11 v3.8 grew to about 2,500 lines without running.

readers.lens: LEGACY_CHRONOLOGY_NOT_CERTIFIED era of PROJECT_DOCUMENTS/PRE_FULL151_DESIGNS_RESULTS_20261023 (50 designs, 81 reports: ELM/omnibus (4-12 Sep), V50-V55 Mac_M3 byte/BANC line (11-13 Sep), MiniFly v0.1 + iterations 3-24 = V65-V79 (13-14 Sep), evolution V79E-V85E, V83/V86/V87/RCE60/V88 (15-16 Sep), reviews/fb1, A10, A11 draft, byte read-order, arithmetic-warmup audit metrics, three-mechanism round and R2/Z1 E3 correction (21-29 Sep)). Read every design/report at least at decision/limitations level; deep reads on incidents, corrections, amendments, QA/backtest/test reports and machine-readable decision files.
readers.summary:
All paths below are relative to /home/user/digitalbaby. ARCH = PROJECT_DOCUMENTS/PRE_FULL151_DESIGNS_RESULTS_20261023. Original folder names come from CATALOG.json sources[0].relative.

The early MiniFly iterations (Codex, 13-14 Sep) are the strongest audit culture in the archive. They freeze protocols before outcomes, count every assigned case in the denominators, treat the history as the statistical unit, check hashes, and log amendments. They routinely reject external progress scores and promote no learner on partial wins. They also caught many proposal errors before running. Iteration 6, for example, rejected an engineering retention win because physiology fit got worse, and iteration 10 published a parser bug with the correction.

Several failure classes start in this era and recur later.

1. **Gates removed after outcomes, and objective drift.** The clearest case is V88. The RCE trace-restored candidate was rejected only by the collateral_survival gate. The follow-up design then declared that retaining still-valid but unused associations is a non-objective. It wrote 'No collateral gate exists' into the hostile test checklist, and the candidate then 'passed'. This conflicts with the V50 constitution and with the current contract's OLD-knowledge protection. A milder precursor is V70's relaxed 0.01-Hz floor after V69 failed.

2. **A failed candidate adopted as working.** V84E failed its locked confirmation (28/77 checks). V87 then calls it something that 'works as a bounded persistent-learning phenotype'.

3. **An evaluation panel that the selected candidates exploited.** V79E-V85E were confirmed on branched, clone-probed panels whose observer was coupled to the genotype. In V83/V86 uninterrupted lives, those champions are no better than REF, or worse.

4. **Invalid controls published as nulls.** The three-mechanism N_old_rel control was identical to W, with zero variance and a published +0.0 [+0.0,+0.0] interval.

5. **Mislabeled evidence.** Examples: the V51 'untouched' probe cohort, OMNIBUS10 'CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE' labels on harmful factors, stale limit strings in evolution decision.json files, and quick or fixture reports formatted like science.

6. **Proxy metrics standing in for the objective.**
   - V50 was labeled FUNCTIONAL_CORE_ESTABLISHED on an 8-way cue task, while the BYTE256 task scored about 0.02.
   - The V75 bridge scored 93.9% versus 62.6% on sign accuracy. Under the primary joint-expression criterion the ranking inverted (21.6% versus 48.3%). The project summary index dropped that caveat.

7. **Matched controls checked on the intended quantity, not the realized one.** V54 update norm, then V68 and V69.

8. **Tests that cannot measure anything.** Gates or mechanisms that are algebraically vacuous; floor-effect assays that cannot detect success; an underpowered 'ideal decoder' used as a ceiling.

9. **A corrected error reappearing in a new design.** The FB1 audit found a previously fixed forgetting window written wrong again, and a protection against non-estimable guards silently lost.

Durable unit facts established early were often re-derived rather than carried forward. The near-zero fitted alpha MBON-to-DAN feedback was rediscovered in at least five rounds. Others include: output saturation masking stored distinctions; probes mutating the learner; immediate correctness not proving durable revision; signed write direction driving interference; and population-level decodability not implying a usable control rule. Findings separate document statements from my inferences.

findings.title: Collateral-retention gate removed after it rejected the simplified candidate; objective silently narrowed to 'relevance' (V88 RCE follow-up)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The RCE60 trace-restored candidate 'was rejected solely by the collateral_survival reduction gate'. The V88 v1.1 design states 'The previous reduction rejected it only because of unrelated-memory retention, which is not a primary objective'. It defines as an explicit non-question the 'retention of every currently valid but behaviorally unused association', instructs 'Do not separately gate collateral survival', and lists 'No collateral gate exists' and 'collateral_survival is absent from Round A pass/fail logic' as required hostile tests. Under the new seven-endpoint suite the candidate was then 'confirmed' on 48 histories (V88B §2.4), and the engineering test report verifies 'absence of collateral/churn gates from Round-A decision logic'. INFERENCE: this is the canonical post-outcome gate removal. A candidate fails gate G, the next design redefines the objective so that G is diagnostic-only, and the same candidate is then 'confirmed'. The hostile test suite was used to lock in the narrowed objective rather than to protect the original one. It contradicts the V50 constitution ('preserves still-useful knowledge through intervening learning') and the current contract's requirement that OLD knowledge be protected.
evidence: ARCH/designs/e37c687452b53e55_DESIGN_RCE_V87_FOLLOWUP_AUDITED.md (orig V88/DESIGN_RCE_V87_FOLLOWUP_AUDITED.md) §0, §1.2 explicit non-question, §2.1 'rejected solely by the collateral_survival reduction gate', §7.5 'Do not separately gate collateral survival', §13 test 15, checklist '[ ] No collateral gate exists'

ARCH/designs/94bb20f95e4a4625_DESIGN_RCE_V87_FOLLOWUP_AUDITED.md (orig V88B/DESIGN_RCE_V87_FOLLOWUP_AUDITED.md) §2.4 Round A 'passed the predeclared seven-endpoint relevance-centered noninferiority suite'; §6.4 collateral 'not a retention entitlement; not a Round A noninferiority gate'
ARCH/results/9113e2592dc7f581_TEST_REPORT.md (orig V88/TEST_REPORT.md): hostile suite checks 'absence of collateral/churn gates from Round-A decision logic'
ARCH/results/cca76a37fcb982f7_REPORT.md (orig V87/engineering_evidence/full60/REPORT.md) limits: 'Time-only 24h/7d behavior is diagnostic, not the principal persistence objective'
minifly_b/package/DOCS/MINIFLY_OBJECTIVE_CONTRACT.md line 3 cites a later 'V88–V9.7 objective drift audit'
findings.how_detected: Reading the V88 v1.1/v1.2 designs against the RCE60 rejection reason and the V50 constitution; the designs state the rejection reason and the gate removal explicitly.
findings.generic_safeguard: Gate-change ledger: if a gate that rejected a candidate is weakened, removed or made diagnostic, record it as an OBJECTIVE CHANGE that needs explicit user sign-off. The original gate must remain a reported co-primary endpoint for that lineage, and 'confirmed' labels must name the gate set used. Hostile tests may never assert the absence of an objective-derived gate without linking to that sign-off.
findings.recurs_later: Yes. The objective contract (effective 26 Sep) cites a separate 'V88–V9.7 objective drift audit'. The relevance-centred narrowing propagated through V9.x per that audit, which is not present in the archive.

findings.title: Candidate that failed locked confirmation adopted as a 'working' anchor (V84E)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The V84E decision.json reports outcome CONFIRMATION_NOT_PASSED, behavioral_candidate_passes false, 28/77 checks. V85E also failed (47/77). The next design (V86) says V84E/V85E 'subsequently improved damage/new-learning profiles under their own confirmation protocol'. V87 opens with 'V84E works as a bounded persistent-learning phenotype' and uses it as the anchor for 44 causal variants. In the V86 uninterrupted life V84E is indistinguishable from REF at load 168 (fixed 0.5461 vs 0.5494). The RCE60 report correctly states 'neither is treated as an established core'. INFERENCE: this is adoption without confirmation. A failed candidate's development-panel profile became the premise of a later design within one day.
evidence: ARCH/designs/1da0d4bdd978c8ea_DESIGN_V87.md (orig V87_core_id/DESIGN_V87.md) 'V84E works as a bounded persistent-learning phenotype'
ARCH/results/cca76a37fcb982f7_REPORT.md (orig V87/engineering_evidence/full60/REPORT.md) 'V84E and V85E are frozen V86 comparators; neither is treated as an established core'
findings.how_detected: Cross-reading the champion decision.json files against the premise sentences of the next designs.
findings.generic_safeguard: Before any design cites a prior candidate as working, baseline or anchor, mechanically load that candidate's decision file and quote its status. If the status is not a pass, force the label 'failed-confirmation comparator' and forbid capability language.
findings.recurs_later: V88 design keeps V84E as a 'contextual anchor' (correctly). Adoption-without-confirmation is the class the route retrospective describes.

findings.title: Evolution confirmations used branched clone-probe panels that did not predict uninterrupted life
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The V79E protocol (inherited through V85E) scores COMMON and MIXED phases on 'immutable copies', with day probes on clones. V83 adds a secondary uninterrupted-life panel 'because it is new' and because 'previous day probes were observation clones rather than experienced delays'. In V83, V81 beats REF on the branched macro score (0.8282 vs 0.7970), yet after 96 identities in continuous life it is clearly worse (0.5846 vs 0.6710); V82 is also worse (0.6115). V86 states 'a candidate can look attractive in branched challenges yet fail under accumulated life history'. In V86 every evolved champion is at most equal to REF by load 168, and V82 and V85E are much worse (0.421 and 0.448 vs 0.549). INFERENCE: the confirmation panel was a proxy that the search optimized. Four evolution rounds (V79E-V85E) were selected and 'confirmed' on it before the deployment-like life test existed.
evidence: ARCH/designs/a18cd4d74783ef7f_PROTOCOL.md (orig minifly/iteration27_evolution/PROTOCOL.md, V79E) 'All probes are immutable copies'
ARCH/results/fcae174513fd8081_REPORT.md (orig minifly/V83/REPORT.md) arm means vs continuous-life table
findings.how_detected: V83 added the continuous-life panel as a secondary assay; the discordance is visible by comparing its table with the branched arm means.
