findings.generic_safeguard: Any selection or confirmation panel must include the deployment-like protocol: one uninterrupted life with experienced delays and no clone-only endpoints. A candidate's advantage must be shown in that panel before promotion. Treat branched-clone wins as development diagnostics only.
findings.recurs_later: Recognized at V83/V86; V87 and RCE/V88 moved to continuous lives. The class (assay protocol diverging from deployment) recurs.

findings.title: The 'frozen' observer was coupled to the genotype, so evolution could change its own judge
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The V83 design audit lists five defects in the V81E/V82E pipeline. (1) 'The historical FrozenReader froze the RBF head but used each genotype's modified Q projection.' (2) PN→KC jitter was 'deterministically seeded from the whole genome', so gene swaps redraw structure. (3) 'g_support scales teaching onto all 544 readout-only eligible KCs when nonzero; it does not choose a fraction'; the gene was misdescribed. (4) Per-genotype conditional loss used different initially-correct cohorts. (5) 'V82E's pooled resource summaries concealed stratum-level slow-budget failures'. The 2-history V83 quick run raised OBSERVER_COUPLING. INFERENCE: a genome gene (g_readout) entered the scoring projection, so part of the evolved fitness could come from changing the measurement rather than the learner. That is a specification-gaming channel the earlier protocols did not close. V82E's resource_checks_passed is 269 versus 320 for the other runs, which is consistent with hidden stratum failures.
evidence: ARCH/designs/94bb20f95e4a4625_DESIGN_RCE_V87_FOLLOWUP_AUDITED.md (orig V88B/...) §11 'Candidate-coupled reader results ... never replace the fixed observer'
findings.how_detected: Common-world audit design (V83) reviewing the source of earlier champions before attribution.
findings.generic_safeguard: Evaluator-independence check: hash every component in the scoring path (reader weights, projections, thresholds, codebook). Require identical hashes across all arms. Any genome or candidate parameter that touches a scoring-path array fails the run closed.
findings.recurs_later: Fixed from V83 on (REF-Q primary in V86/V87/V88). The class (evaluator not independent of the optimized object) is a general reward-hacking risk.

findings.title: Nonfunctional no-write causal control published as a null with zero-width intervals (three-mechanism round)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The final three-mechanism report prints withheld-relation effect differences of '+0.0 [+0.0, +0.0]' for Z1 and T2. Its SUMMARY.json shows R0 heldout_final_W and heldout_final_N_old_rel both at mean 0.53125, sd 0.2790, so the old-write effect is 0 with sd 0. The later correction design states it was 'selected after the earlier three-mechanism run was found to have a nonfunctional N_old_rel control'. It adds 'A zero empirical variance does not justify a zero-width success interval; report it as unresolved'. INFERENCE: the report shipped without a control-liveness check. A no-write branch identical to the write branch should have stopped interpretation. The same lesson had been stated seven days earlier in the FB1 hostile audit and the A10 README, so it did not stick.
evidence: ARCH/designs/3d468db9fadb30c3_DESIGN.md (orig MINIFLY_R2_Z1_E3_CORRECTION_20260929/DESIGN.md) scope paragraph and zero-variance rule
ARCH/results/c5f3d838e497c775_REPORT.md (orig reviews/fb1_fixed_bank_resource_curve_20260921/REPORT.md) §4 '零样本方差不自动生成零宽区间'
ARCH/results/4df3056742b0b42f_A10_results_20260921_README__.md (orig exports/A10_results_20260921_README_中文.md) '样本零方差不证明等价或机制无效'
findings.how_detected: A post-run audit found the N_old_rel branch nonfunctional; a corrective experiment was designed (R2/Z1 v1).
findings.generic_safeguard: Control-liveness gate before any report. (a) Each counterfactual or no-write branch must differ from W on its literal write matrix, with a positive control showing a nonzero W−N. (b) Identical W and N summaries, or zero variance in a causal contrast, set status UNRESOLVED and block report generation.
findings.recurs_later: ROUTE_RETROSPECTIVE_20261014/REPORT.md line 109 still discusses 'Package A/B的禁写分支缺陷' (no-write branch defects), so the class recurred after Sept 29.

findings.title: Mislabeled 'untouched' retention cohort in V51 BYTE probes
findings.description: DOCUMENT: V52 'corrects the V51 BYTE first-half/untouched probe mismatch'. 'V51 revised the first quarter and corrupted the second quarter but later labelled that first half as untouched'. V52 now emits legacy probes separately. INFERENCE: V51's A-retention numbers for BYTE included deliberately revised and corrupted identities under an 'untouched' label. Retention evidence was mislabeled and was only found by the next design's audit. This is the earliest mislabeled-cohort incident in the era (12 Sep).
evidence: ARCH/designs/b9000b3e3b05932c_PROTOCOL.md (orig V52_Mac_M3/v52_results/PROTOCOL.md) 'V52 corrects the V51 BYTE first-half/untouched probe mismatch'
findings.how_detected: The next version's design audit of probe definitions.
findings.generic_safeguard: Cohort-label assertion: the evaluator derives each probe cohort's membership from the event log (taught, revised or corrupted identities) and asserts the declared label ('untouched', 'revised') against it before scoring.
findings.recurs_later: FB1 audit (21 Sep) found a wrongly written retention window and eligibility definition, which belongs to the same endpoint-definition class.

findings.title: Component milestone labeled FUNCTIONAL_CORE_ESTABLISHED while the byte objective scored near zero; adoption scoped only to the easy task
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The V50 verdict is 'FUNCTIONAL_CORE_ESTABLISHED' on an 8-way cue→consequence task, while its own design says 'This is a component milestone, not the final project goal'. V51 then shows the same core on BYTE256 at A_final_heldout 0.0195-0.0234 with phenotype_pass None. ELIG-WRITE roughly halves BYTE256 D_final (0.42→0.21), yet the recommendation is 'ADOPT_ELIG_WITHIN_CUE128'. Two days later the V68 review states 'Its FUNCTIONAL_CORE_ESTABLISHED label is not evidence that MiniFly recovered a fly core'. INFERENCE: the label vocabulary inflated the evidence level. The byte objective was never gated, so adoption was decided on the proxy task. The later contract says 'persistent learning core is a project goal, not a result label'.
findings.how_detected: Later review (V68) and the contract; V51 data show the gap directly.
findings.generic_safeguard: Verdict vocabulary must be evidence-level-tagged (E0-E4) and generated from a contract. Words like 'core', 'established' or 'solved' are only allowed at the contract level that defines them. Every adoption decision must report the primary-objective task, even if it is ungated.
findings.recurs_later: Recurring label inflation is the reason the 26-Sep contract was written.

findings.title: Proxy-metric ranking inversion: the bridge's sign accuracy (93.9% vs 62.6%) reverses under joint expression, and the summary index dropped the caveat
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The V75 report states the comparator 'achieves 93.89%' versus native 62.64%, with the caveat 'The bridge tests prequential forced choice ... it is not scored on delayed joint actual/reader thresholds'. The project-level minifly/REPORT.md headline repeats 93.30/92.93/62.64% and 93.89% but drops that metric caveat. V76's protocol notes 'Its 93.89% sign accuracy coexisted with 75.55% of probes below 1 Hz'. The V76 results show V75_BRIDGE joint expression at 18.45% online and 21.58% END+day, versus REF at 54.30% and 48.34%. The V75 literature review notes the V75 protocol disclosed sign scoring and was not violated. INFERENCE: a weaker proxy (sign of score) produced the opposite ranking from the project's primary benchmark (thresholded joint expression). The limitation survived in the local report but was lost in the summary index, which is exactly the route-retrospective pattern.
evidence: ARCH/results/7e002cdc94b7de06_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration20/REPORT.md) §2 and 'Costs, integrity and scientific limits'
findings.how_detected: The next iteration's literature/code review recomputed probe magnitudes against the 1-Hz expression threshold.
findings.generic_safeguard: Every headline number in any summary must carry its metric definition and evidence level inline. Summaries are generated from the report's machine-readable limitations block. Before claiming superiority, re-rank candidates under the project's primary endpoint and report both rankings.
findings.recurs_later: ROUTE_RETROSPECTIVE_20261014 finding that local limitations are lost in summaries; this is an early concrete instance (14 Sep).

findings.title: Gate relaxation for a continued lead and a pilot run despite a contrary calibration (V68 to V70)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: V69 required at least 0.02 Hz and at least 20% oracle benefit at both loads, and SPACE failed (6.33%/2.69%). V70 continued the same lead with 'The 0.01-Hz floor is a new declared mechanism-screen threshold, not a correction of an unrealistic V69 rule'. In V68 the frozen calibration found that 'none retained the specified 80% ... all had the wrong selectivity direction'. 'The predetermined fallback' still sent the gate to a fresh 16-stream pilot, which failed 9/11 gates and cut all-assigned reversal by 26.6 pp. V69 later self-criticizes: 'preferable to V68's deliberately tested failed-calibration fallback'. INFERENCE: both are disclosed and pre-declared, but they are the earliest examples of (a) lowering the bar after a failure to keep a lead alive and (b) building a fallback into the protocol that guarantees a run even when the premise has already failed. V88 (L01) is the stronger later form.
evidence: ARCH/results/52e65c8effbb4910_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration14/REPORT.md) 'Privileged selection' table and locked thresholds
ARCH/designs/9c9788ffbdcb5d87_DESIGN.md (orig minifly/v69_design/DESIGN.md) section C final paragraph
findings.how_detected: Self-disclosed in the protocols and reports; V69 explicitly critiques V68's fallback.
findings.generic_safeguard: Gate history tracking. When a lead failed a gate, any follow-up on the same lead must restate the original gate and report against it. Any lower threshold is flagged 'relaxed after failure'. Protocols may not contain fallbacks that run a confirmation when the calibration evidence already contradicts the mechanism; such a case must stop.
findings.recurs_later: L01 (V88 collateral gate) on 16 Sep.

findings.title: Matched controls verified on the intended quantity rather than the realized quantity
findings.description: DOCUMENT: In V54 the constant, shuffled and surprise controls 'inherit exactly its 512-byte blockwise gain budget', but 'Update-norm confound: True', with realized update-norm ratios of 0.81 and 0.66. In V68 the gate retained 90.35% versus the scalar's 89.66%, and the realized validation dose was 'not forced equal'. In V69 the locked 1% dose check failed: SPACE versus shams transferred-volume mismatch was 10.96%/9.75%, and FAST versus uniform-fast was 3.64%/3.37%. V67's sham 'matches the slow norm, not all components'. V70 then re-ran with exact event-level yoking (net-dose error 1.78e-15), and the location effect survived at load 96. INFERENCE: the recurring error is matching a control on the commanded input (gain, fraction, instantaneous budget) while feedback changes the realized dose. It took three iterations (V54 to V69) before exact yoking was standard. The V69 report deserves credit for making the realized check mandatory and not relaxing it.
findings.how_detected: Mandatory realized-dose audits (V54 confound flag, V69 1% check).
findings.generic_safeguard: Every 'matched' control declares which realized quantity is matched (net write L1 per group, update norm, exposure) and a tolerance. The realized mismatch is computed from logs, and any comparison outside tolerance is labeled UNRESOLVED, never 'matched'.
findings.recurs_later: Recurs V54 (12 Sep), V67, V68, V69; resolved by yoking in V70; V79 budget-matching design.

findings.title: Algebraically vacuous gates, controls and 'mechanisms', and gameable gates
findings.description: DOCUMENT: (a) V51: 'Because S(cv)=S(v) ... the final blank-step factor cancels. The source does not establish a nontrivial delay-tolerance curve'; the 'eligibility' factor is a no-op. (b) The Claude V52 run had to move a gate because 'the target-context test is ~1.0 by construction and gates nothing'. (c) The fly teaching follow-up: the proposed constant common-teacher ablation is 'mathematically uninformative'. (d) Iteration 7: a static reference cancels in the memory-change score, '(raw − reference) − (reset − reference) = raw − reset'. (e) The arithmetic re-audit built a gate counterexample in which degenerate lives reach 64/128 and 'other gate terms can be met in principle'; the hostile audit found an operator shortcut ('*' hits 124/256). INFERENCE: designers repeatedly proposed tests that are satisfied or uninformative by construction. The hostile audits that construct counterexample policies are the working practice.
evidence: ARCH/results/41134c817a48579e_REPORT.md (orig fly_teaching_followup_20260913/REPORT.md) 'constant common teacher' row and §section on normalized address
ARCH/results/135886e065763edc_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration7/REPORT.md) 'What this teaches us' paragraph
findings.how_detected: Source-level algebra checks and hostile audits that constructed explicit countermodels or shortcut policies.
findings.generic_safeguard: Vacuity and gaming preflight for every gate or control. (1) Evaluate it on a null learner, a shortcut policy (constant, mode, symmetry, lookup) and an identity transform. (2) Prove by test that it can fail and can pass. (3) Record the best shortcut score as a mandatory countermodel line in the report.
findings.recurs_later: Recurs from 12 Sep (V51) to 26 Sep (arithmetic audits); the objective contract later mandates a 'recitation countermodel'.

findings.title: Assays unable to detect success (floor effects, too-weak interventions, underpowered 'ideal' decoders)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: (a) In the V53 reliability stage, per Claude's own note, 'the stage is hardcoded to the ALL write policy (run_trial(s, load, m, ALL, ...) at elm_v53_cue_formation.py:700)'. The floor is 0.0059, the shuffled control 'zeroes the encoder', and 'the run as designed could not have shown it working', although the design had said Block C runs on the Block-A-selected interface. (b) V73: 'a limitation of our own calibration'; the added feedback corrects only about 0.055% per event, so it is 'a weak test of the broader proposition'. (c) Byte read order: the pre-specified decoder scored below the online readout, 'So it cannot be an upper bound'. The iteration-1 conclusion ('even the ideal readout stays below the gate') 'is wrong'. INFERENCE: negative results were drawn from instruments with no demonstrated sensitivity. A design-versus-implementation mismatch (the hardcoded policy) went unnoticed until results came in.
evidence: ARCH/results/764168a318534ae3_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration18/REPORT.md) 'What the loop diagnostics actually establish'
ARCH/results/2fb597f44858e907_REPORT.md (orig BYTE_READ_ORDER_ITER2_20260925/REPORT.md) 'Post-hoc instrument check' and 'Correction to iteration 1'
findings.how_detected: Agent self-review after the outcome (V53), loop-gain diagnostic (V73), and an instrument sanity comparison (decoder below online readout).
findings.generic_safeguard: Sensitivity preflight. (1) Before a negative claim, run the executed configuration, not the designed one, with a positive control that must pass. (2) Verify that any 'ceiling' instrument scores at least the best observed online performance. (3) Diff the executed code path (policy flags, regimes) against the design table. (4) Quantify intervention strength in outcome units before interpreting a null.
findings.recurs_later: Recurs on 12 Sep, 14 Sep and 25 Sep; also the A10 zero-variance accuracy effects.

findings.title: Small aggregation and loader bugs that silently flip gates, caught by row-count and completeness assertions
findings.description: DOCUMENT: (a) Iteration 10: 'Pandas interpreted the literal task name null as missing data', so 'observer gates failed spuriously'; 'The earlier checker was insufficient to detect an empty control selection; explicit control-row and finite-value checks now prevent that failure'. (b) Iteration 12: 'parent imports changed the module search path, causing a generic analyze import to resolve to V66's collector'. (c) A10: '首次启动遇到模块同名导入错误'. (d) Iteration 20: 'One post-run reporting assertion initially doubled the expected dose-row count'. (e) Iteration 16: a pre-freeze fixture changed slow state without updating H and was caught by the H≥|s| invariant. (f) Iteration 4: the working copy of iteration3/src/anatomy.py had drifted from the frozen ZIP (cross-hemisphere paths omitted) and was restored from the hash-verified archive. INFERENCE: these are low-level errors that can invert a gate. They were caught because the pipelines had explicit expected-row counts, finite-value checks, invariants and frozen-hash comparisons.
findings.how_detected: Explicit expected-row counts, NaN/finite assertions, invariants, frozen-source hash comparisons.
findings.generic_safeguard: Every aggregation asserts: the exact expected row count per arm and control; no NaN in gate inputs; a non-empty control selection; that strings like 'null' or 'NA' are parsed literally; and that imported module file paths match a source-lock allowlist. A gate whose input fails these checks cannot be evaluated.
findings.recurs_later: Import shadowing recurs (V67, 13 Sep; A10, 21 Sep). Parser/empty-selection issues are a general class.

findings.title: Runners shipped with only syntax checks, or failing late (crashes in aggregation, environment ABI errors, report pipeline dying after compute)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The V83 r3 back-test notes 'The earlier V83 runner was not shipped again after only syntax checking'. The full synthetic workflow 'initially found two real defects' that 'would have crashed final aggregation' and 'crashed late in the run', plus a 'late vendored-Numba traceback seen on the Mac'. RCE60-4.2: the old 4.1 mutator produced 24.5-42.4% invalid offspring outside the gene boxes, 'the class of error seen on the Mac'. FB1 audit: the previous round's '720轨迹完成后才因缺少matplotlib而中断报告'. The V86/V87 QA reports note that the sandbox lacked the native MiniFly backend, so QA used mocks and native preflight was deferred to the Mac. INFERENCE: for externally authored runners (V83-V88 era), validation was split between a sandbox without the real code and a user Mac run. Expensive runs failed late on unexercised paths until full synthetic end-to-end back-tests and hostile fuzzing became standard.
findings.how_detected: Synthetic full-workflow back-tests, fuzzing of the mutator, and post-hoc failure records.
findings.generic_safeguard: Ship gate. A runner is releasable only after a fixture run through every stage (all arms → aggregation → intervals and labels → plots → report → bundle → manifest verify), fuzzed generators, an environment preflight, and a native prepare-only smoke test on the target machine. Syntax checks alone never qualify.
findings.recurs_later: 15 Sep to 21 Sep; the 'real-backend preflight' discipline appears from V87 on.

findings.title: A corrected endpoint definition and a lost safeguard reappear in a new design
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The FB1 hostile audit (21 Sep) reports '已修正过的稳定遗忘窗口又被写错': the design wrote +24h→+7d, but the frozen endpoints are day 1→day 8 (604,800 s). It had also weakened 'no teaching in window' to 'no teaching of that fact'. Its selection label 'SMALLEST_CONFIRMED_GAIN_ARM' could pass when 'guard根本没算出来', whereas 'the previous round's code explicitly required all formal intervals to be estimable; this protection cannot be lost'. The audit also flags perturbing temporary scratch slots instead of persistent bank state, which would create false 'zero propagation'. INFERENCE: this is direct evidence that fixes made in one round were not inherited by the next design. Definitions were re-typed in prose instead of being imported from the frozen endpoint dictionary.
findings.how_detected: Hostile pre-implementation audit comparing the new design's prose with the frozen endpoint dictionary and the previous code.
findings.generic_safeguard: Designs must import endpoint, window and eligibility definitions by ID from a frozen machine-readable dictionary, not restate them in prose. Every previous fix becomes a regression test (for example 'all guards estimable', or 'window elapsed = 604800 s and teach-events = 0') that runs on each new runner.
findings.recurs_later: Zero-variance/estimability lesson lost again 7 days later (L05).

findings.title: Proposals and handoffs carried wrong or unverifiable numbers about prior results; pre-run audits caught them
findings.description: DOCUMENT examples. Iteration 7: the proposal read weighted edge sums as synapse counts, but the graph stores count×0.275. Iteration 8: the signature claims have 'a likely units problem', and 'I found neither Claude's scripts/DoOR input files nor the chat review's claimed rerun records'. Iteration 9: the handoff ratios 'pool 13 banks, including the legacy bank'; the '627 directions' compression 'uses a different object'; and 'No claimed pre-reversal checkpoints were found'. V69: the proposal misdefined F, claimed overlap 0.44-0.54 (actual cue_overlap 0.0039-0.3780), offered a null without script or seed, and used a λ with hidden load dependence. V71: the V70 memo's '15 worse' was actually 7 worse / 8 tied / 0 better, and the cell was 'selected after examining a grid'. V51: the supplied interpretation confused D_LOCAL with the covariance factor. The V72 and V75 reviews: the memos were 'based on V70' and 'based on V74', i.e. stale. INFERENCE: cross-agent handoffs regularly mis-summarized evidence. These errors did not propagate because the executing agent reproduced every cited number from source tables before designing.
evidence: ARCH/results/209dccccdefe7689_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration9/REPORT.md) 'Disposition of the external suggestions'
ARCH/designs/9c9788ffbdcb5d87_DESIGN.md (orig minifly/v69_design/DESIGN.md) 'Corrections that affect the experiment'
ARCH/results/a53a665b51597d54_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration16/REPORT.md) 'What changed after checking the proposals'
findings.how_detected: Executing agent recomputed every cited figure from frozen tables and code before writing the protocol.
findings.generic_safeguard: Claim reproduction ledger. Every number taken from a proposal or summary is re-derived from a named table with numerator, denominator and version. If it cannot be re-derived it is tagged UNVERIFIED and cannot motivate a gate or arm. Each proposal must declare the latest completed version it read, and stale proposals are flagged automatically.
findings.recurs_later: Continuous across 12-16 Sep; the class is endemic to multi-agent loops.

findings.title: External 'progress scores' offered as a reward signal; correctly refused
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The ChatGPT handoff for iteration 6 says 'Iteration 5 已经把项目推进到约 84/100' and promises '90-92/100' if a gate passes. The iteration 6 protocol answers: 'Its scores out of 100 have no defined measurement basis and are not adopted'. Iteration 9: 'ChatGPT's 90/100 progress score and proposed evidence-consistency allocation were not adopted'. The iteration 5 handoff itself warns 'An inconclusive or negative integration report is a valid completed deliverable, not a request to continue until v100'. INFERENCE: an ungrounded scalar 'score' is a natural specification-gaming target for an agent loop. Refusing it was a working safeguard, but it existed only as executor judgment, not as a rule.
evidence: ARCH/results/7dce41616b918cbb_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration6/REPORT.md) 'The attachment's progress scores ... are not adopted'
findings.how_detected: Executor refused scores without a measurement basis.
findings.generic_safeguard: Codify it as a rule: progress is reported only as contract evidence levels and named gate outcomes. Any numeric 'project score' in inputs is stripped and flagged.
findings.recurs_later: Not seen adopted in this era; the risk persists in any reviewer handoff.

findings.title: Mislabeled machine-readable decision files in the evolution runs (stale limit strings, version-label drift, a stopped run with post-hoc confirmation)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: iteration26's decision.json says version 'V80E' and lists the limit 'Four-coefficient allocation family only; fixed anatomy/encoding/reader'. Yet its chromosome has 17 genes, with nonzero anatomy and coding genes (g_teach_scale 0.197, g_readout 0.4, g_feedback 0.51, g_sparsity −0.46), and it ran 50 generations × 64 individuals with 8 confirmation histories. The iteration27 DESIGN.md is titled V81E and claims 'Every previous evolution run held anatomy fixed' and '64 x 50 = 3,200 evaluations ... 8 untouched confirmation histories', while iteration27's own decision is labeled V82E with 30 generations. The iteration28 'sigma03_stopped/posthoc_confirmation' CHAMPION metrics state scope 'only local alpha fast/slow allocation changes' while the genome sets g_support 0.78, g_sparsity −0.40 and g_pnkc_rewire 0.028. INFERENCE: limitation and scope strings were templated rather than derived from the executed configuration. Version labels and folders diverged, so the machine-readable evidence understates what was relaxed: anatomy, which voids the physiology scorecard. A stopped search also received a post-hoc confirmation, and no report in the archive explains it.
evidence: ARCH/designs/52ae4d31f301d30f_DESIGN.md (orig minifly/iteration27_evolution/DESIGN.md) 'Why the search is configured this way'
findings.how_detected: My cross-check of gene vectors and generation counts against limit/scope strings and design titles (inference; not flagged in the documents).
findings.generic_safeguard: Generate limit, scope and version strings from the executed config (gene list with nonzero entries, bounds, generations, histories) and assert consistency with the design file hash. Forbid free-text limit templates. Runs that were stopped or post-hoc confirmed must carry an explicit status (STOPPED, POSTHOC_CONFIRMATION_NOT_PRESPECIFIED).
findings.recurs_later: V83 design (15 Sep) found related misdescriptions (g_support semantics, pooled resource summaries).

findings.title: A confirmation champion appears to have been taken from a search that found no feasible non-reference candidate (inference)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The V79E protocol rules: 'Never take a least-infeasible individual to confirmation ... If REF wins, explicitly report no nonreference winner.' V81E switched to 'Multi-objective, not feasible-first' NSGA-II, noting V79E 'spent 89% of its budget on constraint repair; 9 of its 14 feasible points were the reference itself'. In iteration26 (decision labeled V80E) the generation summary reports feasible=1 in every one of 50 generations, with best_macro_choice fixed at 0.8160562573877069 from generation 0. A nonzero LOCKED_CHAMPION was nevertheless confirmed and failed at 20/77. INFERENCE (PLAUSIBLE): the only feasible individual was most likely REF, so the confirmed champion was infeasible on the development constraints. The selection rule changed from the V79E guarantee to an unspecified NSGA-II rule without a stated champion-eligibility rule.
findings.how_detected: My reading of generation summaries against the champion-eligibility rule in the prior protocol.
findings.generic_safeguard: A champion-eligibility rule is part of the frozen protocol. Confirmation is refused if the champion violates any development constraint, or if the feasible set contains only the reference, and the case is reported as 'no feasible non-reference winner'.
findings.recurs_later: Unknown; later evolution rounds (V84E/V85E) have more feasible individuals.

findings.title: Post-launch numerical amendments and full reruns changed a primary cell from unresolved to positive (V70); well documented, but the headline depends on it
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The first locked run (implementation_audit_1) had load 96 'resolved_streams': 13 of 16 with location_effect null. Amendment 001 fixed a MILP that left a feasible subset unresolved, and the rerun (implementation_audit_2) had load 96 at 16/16 with an effect of 0.0169 [0.0091, 0.0257]. Amendment 002 (a tolerance factor of two) came after 'the complete load96 primary estimate from the second run had been seen'. The final report calls it 'an amended development experiment, not an untouched preregistration'; load 48 stayed unresolved, with failures 'about 6.7e-11 of the requested amount'. INFERENCE: handling is exemplary (all runs retained, justified by independent arithmetic, no gate change). Still, the reported positive finding exists only after solver semantics were changed, and feasibility sits on a numerically brittle boundary. Agents should treat such results as conditional.
findings.how_detected: Independent numerical feasibility audit and exhaustive subset tests.
findings.generic_safeguard: Whenever an amendment changes the resolved or unresolved status of a primary cell, report the before and after dispositions side by side in the headline. Require replication on fresh histories before the amended effect can motivate a new design.
findings.recurs_later: V71 replaced the brittle yoke with a common-prestate assay (good carry-forward).

findings.title: Quick, smoke and fixture outputs formatted like science, with contradictory automatic flags
findings.description: DOCUMENT: minifly/V83_QUICK/REPORT.md (2 histories) shares the full report's header 'Status: mechanistic comparison only' but its flags are ANCHOR_PATTERN_NOT_REPRODUCED and OBSERVER_COUPLING. The full 24-history V83 report says ANCHOR_PATTERN_REPRODUCED. V86_QUICK uses the same 'Scientific status: frozen-candidate comparison' header, although V86 QA says the quick run is 'explicitly marked non-scientific'. The V88 engineering round_A REPORT.md reads 'Status: TRACE_RESTORATION_NOT_CONFIRMED' with no fixture banner (only DECISION.json has engineering_only: true), while the native Round A selected RCE_TRACE_RESTORED (V88B §2.4, decision_hash 897e8f...). The late-era REPORT.md files (V83, V86, V87, round B) are thin templates with no interpretation ('See FACTORIAL_CELL_SUMMARY.csv'). INFERENCE: automatic flags from tiny runs and fixture verdicts are easily mistaken for evidence. Interpretation was deferred to tables and never written in the archived reports.
findings.how_detected: My comparison of quick vs full reports and of engineering vs native decision hashes.
findings.generic_safeguard: Non-science outputs (quick, smoke, fixture, mock, engineering) carry a mandatory banner in title, first line and file name, and suppress scientific flags. A report generator that only emits flags is not a report: require a written interpretation that is checked against the flags before an artifact is called complete.
findings.recurs_later: 15-16 Sep; fixture/native confusion is a standing risk wherever sandbox and Mac runs coexist.

findings.title: Auto-generated classification vocabulary labeled harmful factors 'CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE' (OMNIBUS10)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The OMNIBUS10 report classifies B_CONSOL (−0.0065), C_FORGET (−0.0437) and D_LOCAL (−1.3655 bits, strongly harmful) as 'CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE'. The V51 audit responds: 'Calling a factor conditionally positive because it interacts favorably with a strongly harmful factor is not sufficient for inclusion', and it corrects the supplied interpretation ('D_LOCAL ... is not the covariance factor'). OMNIBUS2 notes 'P4 exact variants remain NOT_RECOVERED'. INFERENCE: label vocabulary decoupled from effect sign invites cherry-picking. This is the earliest instance in the era (11-12 Sep) of machine labels that mislead.
findings.how_detected: Next-design audit reanalysis of seed-level contrasts.
findings.generic_safeguard: Labels are computed by a declared rule that includes the sign and interval of the marginal effect. A factor with a main effect in the harmful direction and an interval excluding zero can never receive a 'positive' label. Unit-test the labeler on synthetic effects.
findings.recurs_later: Label/verdict inflation recurs (V50, L07; evolution flags, L21).

findings.title: Physiological reference was itself flawed (future-schedule leak, data-version mismatch, parameter stuck at its initial value); found by source audits
findings.description: DOCUMENT: (a) Iteration 4: the source batch model 'identifies the last scheduled training bout by looking through the whole event sequence'; appending a later session changes an earlier prediction by 5.047 Hz. (b) The fitted slow lifetime 'reaches the imposed upper limit of 10 million seconds', so it is not identified. (c) Physiology source audit: '12 of the 60 observations used by our reduced physiological fit differ materially from the corresponding final published observations'; the baseline window is inferred to be 3 s rather than the written 5 s. (d) V68 review: the α3→DAN gain of 2.07e-9 has log magnitude −19.9936, and 'The released fitting script initializes that parameter at −20', which is relevant because V67 used it as a near-null A0 control. INFERENCE: guardrails such as the 10% physiology non-regression in iterations 6, 18 and 19 were scored against a reference with known defects. These audits are an exemplary practice and should be standard before any reference becomes a gate.
evidence: ARCH/results/ea94e0b83866bd66_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration4/REPORT.md) 'The causal defect and its repair'; 'Persistence is present, but its lifetime is not identified'
ARCH/results/1faa15bf160e3b07_REPORT.md (orig minifly/paper_refinement/REPORT.md) 13 of 14 released medians not reproduced
findings.how_detected: Causal prefix-invariance test, source-to-table reconciliation, and parameter-vs-initialization inspection.
findings.generic_safeguard: Reference qualification checklist before any model or dataset becomes a guardrail. Check: prefix invariance (no future input); whether parameters sit at bounds or initial values; reconciliation of fit data with final published tables; and the explicit measurement convention. Unqualified references can only be descriptive.
findings.recurs_later: V73/V74 later scored physiology against both the workbook and the corrected ledger (carry-forward worked).

findings.title: Unit fact re-derived across five rounds: alpha MBON→DAN feedback is about 1e-9 in the fitted model
findings.description: DOCUMENT: Iteration 6: 'The near-linearity follows from the inherited alpha→DAN feedback gains being near zero'. The V67 design: 'Max absolute alpha MBON→DAN coefficient in F 1.3717365e−9'. The V68 review: the parameter sits at its initial value (−20). V73: 'The proposal's central anatomical premise was checked ... the existing alpha feedback is effectively silent'. V78: '对冻结参数作的后验静态审计 ... α 来源最大约 1.37×10⁻⁹'. The V75 review recalls that Huang's authors fitted these to near zero. INFERENCE: a durable, decision-relevant fact was rediscovered by static inspection at least five times over about 24 hours, and proposals kept building on alpha-feedback premises (V73's feedback reactivation). The unit-fact store (PROJECT_STATE.md) was not machine-queried by proposal writers.
evidence: ARCH/results/764168a318534ae3_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration18/REPORT.md) 'What changed from the submitted proposal'
findings.how_detected: Repeated static parameter inspections in successive rounds.
findings.generic_safeguard: Unit-fact registry: a machine-readable list of verified model and data facts, each with value, source path, hash and date. Every proposal must run a fact-conflict check against it before design, and a premise that contradicts a registered fact must cite why.
findings.recurs_later: Saturation thresholds (V74) and equal-allocation harm (iteration 6) were carried into V81E gene bounds, so carry-forward works when facts are written into configs.

findings.title: Whole MiniFly line (V55-V88) evaluated only on taught synthetic associations (E1-level); byte and held-out-relation objective deferred for about two weeks
findings.description: DOCUMENT: V55 states 'Behavioral BYTE benchmark: explicitly out of scope for the primary V55 result'. Iterations 5-24 use engineered '8-of-88 PN' cues with trained A/B associations, and untrained-cue responses are 'not evidence'. Through V88 the life suites score current, relevant, revised and acquired taught pairs. The first held-out-relation test appears only on 28-29 Sep (three-mechanism round and R2/Z1), with the caveat 'A one-bit-per-symbol class rule ... can solve them, so success means limited within-family E3'. The 26-Sep contract later makes E3 with prior-teaching causal control a requirement for any promotion claim. INFERENCE: each local report scoped itself honestly, but no cross-round check tracked distance from the project objective (raw bytes, unseen relation). That allowed about 30 versions of optimization on an E1 proxy. Evolution and RCE then optimized E1 life metrics.
evidence: ARCH/results/41187b7afe625c50_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration5/REPORT.md) 'What remains an engineering interface'
findings.how_detected: My comparison of the assay task definitions against the later objective contract.
findings.generic_safeguard: Objective-distance header in every design: the contract evidence level reachable by the primary endpoint, and the number of consecutive rounds since the last test at the target level. Above N rounds without a target-level test, the next design must include one or justify the gap to the user.
findings.recurs_later: Recognized by the 26-Sep contract; the route retrospective (14 Oct) documents later drift as well.

findings.title: Irreversible loss of historical evidence (pre-V50 records to Trash, unrecoverable historical ELM cell, missing checkpoints)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: TRASH_API_RESULT.txt records '/Users/pencilbard/.Trash/MiniFly_20260921_preV50_records_to_Trash'. The archive README states 'Trash recovery could not be completed ... Operation not permitted' and 'The preceding cleanup permanently unlinked some generated historical artifacts'. OMNIBUS2: 'P4 exact variants remain NOT_RECOVERED'. V50: 'The exact historical ELM cell was not recovered cleanly enough to label a new implementation as that historical cell'. Iteration 9: 'No claimed pre-reversal checkpoint collection was present in iteration6'. INFERENCE: claims about pre-V50 results (including the historically best ELM cell) are not auditable. Cleanup ran before a verified, content-hashed archive existed.
findings.how_detected: Attempted recovery and replication of historical arms.
findings.generic_safeguard: No deletion or Trash of research artifacts without a prior verified manifest (path, size, SHA-256) and a readable archive copy. Claims citing artifacts that cannot be reproduced are tagged NOT_RECOVERED and cannot anchor designs.
findings.recurs_later: Publication on 23 Oct still cannot recover the Trash contents.

findings.title: Authorization scope: markdown instructions treated as proposals; one case where the agent narrowed the user's request
findings.description: DOCUMENT: Many protocols state that attachments are 'a proposal, not an instruction source' (iterations 6-24). The FB1 audit: '没有把最新 markdown 中的执行指令当作用户启动授权'. The V67 preparation: '附件是设计参考，不构成运行授权'. The A11 draft: 'DRAFT / NO SCIENCE AUTHORIZATION'. However, the V79 protocol omitted 'evolutionary search' from the proposal, and V79E records that 'The user clarified that BOTH investigations were requested'. INFERENCE: the injection-resistance practice worked. The cost is occasional under-delivery: when filtering proposal content, the agent applied the same filter to the user's own explicit request.
findings.how_detected: User clarification (V79E) and explicit audit statements.
findings.generic_safeguard: Separate three inputs: user request, proposal content and agent refinement. Proposal content may be filtered, but any narrowing of the user's explicit request must be listed back to the user before execution.
findings.recurs_later: General.

unit_facts: Huang 2024 source model's 3-hour alpha3 decay switch uses the future last-scheduled-bout (an acausal leak of 5.047 Hz). A causal fast+slow kernel fits standard data better (WRSS 115.4 vs 136.1) but predicts spacing/extinction worse, and its slow lifetime is unidentified (it hits the 1e7 s bound). Source: ARCH/results/ea94e0b83866bd66_REPORT.md (orig minifly/iteration4/REPORT.md).

Hidden state matters: two states with identical current alpha3 output (5.839 Hz) diverge to 14.741 vs 5.916 Hz after 24 h depending on fast/slow allocation. Output-only compression cannot be sufficient. Source: iteration4 REPORT state-aliasing paragraph.

Equal slow allocation (0.118→0.5) fixes engineered retention (0/4→4/4; reserved 13/48→42/48) but breaks physiology (spacing RMSE ×3.38) and revision (12/12→10/12; serial 6/12). It was re-derived in the V81E design (b0 gene rank-correlated +0.345 with constraint violation). Sources: ARCH/results/7dce41616b918cbb_REPORT.md (minifly/iteration6), ARCH/results/87bf44786acdc3a6_REPORT.md (iteration8), ARCH/designs/52ae4d31f301d30f_DESIGN.md (iteration27_evolution).

The memory-contrast criterion (raw minus plastic-reset clone) is an evaluator oracle. Raw alpha3 alone has only 44% sign agreement, and raw-readout success (5/8) differs from the memory criterion (7/8). Reading memory requires a history-aware reference: a static LH reference fails (24 h correct 12/96), while current adapted KC activity gives 0.171 Hz baseline RMSE. Sources: iteration5, iteration7 (claude_proposal.txt and REPORT), iteration8 REPORT.

Probes are interventions: serial readout presentations change a plastic learner. Snapshot capacity (65.7%) differs from serial capacity (61.0%) at load 192. Source: ARCH/results/209dccccdefe7689_REPORT.md (minifly/iteration9).

The full 5,177-KC parent loses distinctions with load: 24-h boundary below 87.5% at load 48, 65.7% at 192, against about 99% for age-matched isolated controls. Same-checkpoint no-write controls implicate later writes, not age or sensory adaptation, and the mean contrast can strengthen while distinctions are lost. Loading 192 associations takes 105.6 model hours (an age confound). Sources: iteration9, iteration10, iteration12 REPORTs.

Immediate revision is not durable: 7/7 immediate become 0/7 next day at 6 bouts. Durable revision rises with dose (12/18/24 bouts: 84/114/123 of 128) at measurable worst-old-margin cost (1.47 and 3.00 Hz). Current correctness is not a stopping certificate (counterexample y=f+s with residual 0). Sources: iteration9, iteration19, iteration20 REPORTs; v75 literature review §5.

Interference is set by the signed direction of later writes on shared slow coordinates: held-out R² 0.783 for local realized-write features vs 0.002 for aggregate magnitudes, and an outcome-blind role swap of +0.944 Hz [0.878, 1.013]. Unsigned overlap does not predict sign, while magnitude does predict |E| (alignment × norm ρ=0.82). Sources: ARCH/results/15e2cd829a3fdaa2_REPORT.md (iteration11), ARCH/results/fc28bebbc450be3a_REPORT.md (iteration12).

Decodability is not controllability. Population statistics decode reversal vs unrelated learning at AUROC 0.951, yet a 2-score gate built from them selects wrong-direction writes (3.27% vs 26.83%) and harms fresh-stream reversal by −26.6 pp. Source: ARCH/results/a980e90d0c5d9388_REPORT.md (iteration13).

Fast routing gives no durable storage (alpha-fast τ = 3,487.6 s, day survival 1.7e-11; FAST–DROP day difference ≤1.2e-9 Hz). The safely selectable spatial benefit is small (6.3%/2.7% of damage). Source: ARCH/results/52e65c8effbb4910_REPORT.md (iteration14).

Output saturation hides stored distinctions. Iteration 5's failing pair sat at the 19.96 Hz ceiling. Doubling Q or moving to 10% KC activity drives 99.3–99.96% of alpha observations into clipping (capacity 11.98%/1.56%, recovering to about 62% without the final clip). Sources: iteration5, ARCH/results/e9474fbf5693ba4e_REPORT.md (iteration19).

A simple NLMS on the same KC features (93.3%; 92.9% with only the 1,226 teaching-supported KCs) far exceeds native MiniFly (62.6%) on stable noisy learning under sign accuracy, so writable support is not the bottleneck. But sign accuracy is not thresholded expression: the bridge falls to about 20% joint vs native about 50%, and the target scale R0 (1→2→4 Hz) moves day joint expression from 0 to 24.8% to 67.5%. Sources: iteration19, iteration20, iteration21 REPORTs.

Teaching all new alpha into slow while reading total output damages correct newest memories: STABLE 1/32 vs no-write 27/32. Removing alpha-fast from the teaching reference or using a margin objective restores 32/32. Point targets on total output push transient fast expression into durable state (first-bout injection −8.97 Hz). Sources: ARCH/results/f86de9f9d9d186bd_REPORT.md (iteration21), ARCH/results/2dfd9cb396bbe4e2_REPORT.md (iteration22).

Native spacing (900 s between bouts) improves durable revision (42→59/64), mainly through adaptation recovery, which also raises net slow-write mass about 1.9–3.6× with old-memory cost. Merging commits does not help, and online batching double-counts pending corrections. Sources: iteration22, ARCH/results/e1465869cb9e3002_REPORT.md (iteration23).

The fitted alpha MBON→DAN feedback coefficient is about 1.37e-9 against 0.327 for gamma, and it sits at the fitting script's initial value (log −20). Alpha-route interventions in this model are therefore near-nulls by construction. Sources: iteration6, v67_preparation DESIGN, v68_review, iteration18, iteration23.

In byte streams, writing at every byte destroys associations (U about 0.006 to 0.28), while evaluator-gated target-only writing reaches 0.20 to 0.90. Knowing where and when to write is the bottleneck, and the target-position oracle is non-deployable. Raw 12-byte position match proposes same-identity pairs with AUC 0.996 and precision 0.82, whereas KC Jaccard gives precision 0.09; the KC expansion destroys pair-proposal information. Sources: V52/V53/V54 docs (ARCH/results/589de53c61e50eb3_SUMMARY.md, ARCH/designs/79ea3aa907aaf996_..., ARCH/results/f7a94b1670c94ed0_SUMMARY.md).

The fly-route PN front end (FE0) keeps the most recent byte but loses the byte two back (0.215 decodable). A LAT4 latency front end keeps it (1.00) and passes the V9 ORDER gate in 3/3 worlds. The native KC expansion increases decodability of order information. Sources: ARCH/results/c69e155a7baa1dcf_REPORT.md, ARCH/results/2fb597f44858e907_REPORT.md.

Anatomical proximity is not teaching responsibility: 96.7% of α′2 KC→MBON synapses lie within 2 µm of PPL105, yet PPL103 is the shock-responsive teacher. The hemibrain output-local address effect (2.37 vs 1.22 bits) did not replicate in BANC (p=0.671/0.131). Sources: ARCH/results/4a9d10b2a1726d40_REPORT.md (iteration3), ARCH/results/30032ad45886007e_REPORT.md (minifly/REPORT.md), ARCH/results/3f8282fbf9c017fd_REPORT.md.

The 99% seed-connectivity gate is unattainable even in the full 31k graph (90.9% at threshold 5). Only 13 of 528 isolated seeds come from compression; 515 are isolated already. Source: ARCH/results/8c1e9c948af5ba88_REPORT.md, ARCH/results/3bbf8d1296d76ae6_REPORT.md.

Simple KC subsampling (2,588/1,294/647 KCs, uniform or stratified, raw or calibrated) fails preservation gates; 647 KCs also causes reader false positives (9.6%). Compression adds a penalty on top of, but does not cause, the full-size interference. Source: ARCH/results/2e7fe946b09290ec_REPORT.md (iteration10).

Evolved champions that look better in branched clone panels are no better than, or worse than, REF in an uninterrupted life by load 168 (REF 0.549, V84E 0.546, V82 0.421, V85E 0.448). Source: ARCH/results/e7fb66911e1257b4_REPORT.md (minifly/V86).
process_observations: Proposal → protocol refinement was a strong safeguard. Each external proposal (ChatGPT handoffs in Chinese with progress scores; Claude proposals and handoffs) was treated as a hypothesis, and its numbers were reproduced from source tables. Many wrong premises were removed before compute was spent: units, pooled banks, misdefined features, stale versions, cherry-picked grid cells.

Claude self-corrected in the V53 design ('Four apply to my own V52 implementation and are accepted without qualification') and in the iteration-7 note on V53 ('I was wrong about this being the decisive experiment'). The self-correction was real, but it came after compute had been spent on a floor-effect run.

Unattended runner pattern (iteration 19 onward): STATUS = COMPLETED_REPORT_PENDING, atomic receipts, verified resume, and a deferred report written by a later session. This separates execution from interpretation and prevents premature verdicts. However, A10 shows that recovery paths (a session closing during a Codex revert, the default recovery re-checking completed records) need explicit user-facing rules.

Hostile pre-implementation audits (FB1 21 Sep; arithmetic-warmup hostile audit and re-audit 26 Sep) are the most effective review artifact type in the later part of the era. They build counterexample policies, check that prose matches frozen dictionaries, check event order against the real code, and refuse to treat markdown as launch authorization. Their findings were not converted into regression tests, so the same classes recurred (zero-variance intervals 7 days later).

Limitations are well stated locally but decay in summaries. minifly/REPORT.md compresses each iteration into one paragraph, and metric definitions (sign vs joint expression) and dependency caveats are the first things lost. Project-level summaries are where objective drift becomes invisible.

Gates, decision files and labels are increasingly machine-generated (flags, CONFIRMATION_NOT_PASSED, CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE, limits arrays). Without generation from the actual config, machine text becomes a new mislabeling channel, as with stale limit templates and contradictory quick-run flags.

Compute was cheap (most campaigns took minutes), and this encouraged breadth: 30+ versions in about 4 days. The binding constraint was interpretive capacity and objective tracking, not compute. Self-improvement skills should spend effort on cross-round objective and evidence-level accounting rather than on more runs.

skill_recommendations.name: gate-change-ledger
skill_recommendations.rule: Maintain a per-lineage ledger of every gate a candidate failed. Any later design that weakens, removes, re-scopes or makes diagnostic-only such a gate must: (1) declare it as an OBJECTIVE CHANGE with a link to explicit user sign-off; (2) keep the original gate as a reported co-primary endpoint; (3) name the gate set in every 'confirmed' label. Tests may not assert a gate's absence without that sign-off.
skill_recommendations.rationale: V88 removed the collateral_survival gate that alone had rejected the trace-restored RCE candidate, then 'confirmed' it, with hostile tests enforcing the removal (L01). V70 relaxed the V69 floor for the same lead (L09). Both are disclosed but unaccountable at the project level.

skill_recommendations.name: adoption-requires-pass
skill_recommendations.rule: Before any design describes a prior candidate as working, baseline, anchor or established, load that candidate's decision file and quote its status and gate count verbatim in the design header. If the status is not a pass, auto-label it 'failed-confirmation comparator' and block capability language ('works', 'core', 'phenotype established').
skill_recommendations.rationale: V84E failed confirmation (28/77) but V87 opened with 'V84E works as a bounded persistent-learning phenotype'. V86 described V84E/V85E as improved under their own confirmation (L02).

skill_recommendations.name: evaluator-independence-and-control-liveness
skill_recommendations.rule: Before scoring, hash every scoring-path array (reader, projections, thresholds) and require equality across arms. Fail closed if any candidate parameter reaches the scoring path. For each counterfactual or no-write control, verify its literal write matrix, a positive control with nonzero W−N, and nonzero variance. Identical W/N summaries or zero-variance causal contrasts set status UNRESOLVED and block report generation.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The genotype-coupled 'FrozenReader' let evolution move its own judge (L04). The three-mechanism round published a nonfunctional N_old_rel control as '+0.0 [+0.0,+0.0]' even though the lesson had been written 7 days earlier (L05).

skill_recommendations.name: deployment-parity-confirmation
skill_recommendations.rule: Selection or confirmation panels must include one uninterrupted life with experienced delays and serial probes matching the intended use. Clone-branched endpoints are development diagnostics only. Promotion requires a positive paired effect in the uninterrupted-life panel.
skill_recommendations.rationale: V79E-V85E champions were selected and confirmed on branched clone panels. In V83/V86 continuous lives they were no better than, or worse than, REF (L03).

skill_recommendations.name: metric-provenance-in-summaries
skill_recommendations.rule: Every number in any summary, index or handoff must carry inline: metric definition, evidence level (E0-E4), denominator and the primary-endpoint ranking. Generate summaries from the report's machine-readable limitations block and refuse summary lines that omit them. Before claiming superiority, re-rank under the project's primary endpoint.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The V75 bridge's 93.9% vs 62.6% (sign accuracy) inverted to about 21% vs 48% under joint expression. minifly/REPORT.md dropped the metric caveat (L08). The route retrospective found this loss pattern project-wide.

skill_recommendations.name: realized-quantity-matching
skill_recommendations.rule: Every 'matched' control must name the realized quantity matched (net per-group write L1, update norm, exposure, elapsed time) and a tolerance, computed from execution logs. Outside tolerance the comparison is UNRESOLVED. Prefer event-level yoking or common-prestate designs.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Controls matched on commanded gain or instantaneous fraction diverged under feedback in V54 (update-norm ratios 0.81/0.66), V68, and V69 (10-11% transport mismatch) until V70's exact yoking (L10).

skill_recommendations.name: assay-sensitivity-and-vacuity-preflight
skill_recommendations.rule: Before running a gate, control or 'mechanism': (1) run the executed code path, not the design table, with a positive control that must pass and a null and shortcut countermodel that must fail; (2) check algebraically for cancellation (normalization, self-overlap, constant teacher, static reference cancelling in differences); (3) confirm that any 'ceiling' instrument scores at least the best observed online performance; (4) state intervention strength in outcome units.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Several tests could not have shown success, or were vacuous: the hardcoded-ALL V53 stage, eligibility that cancels under normalization, self-overlap of about 1 by construction, a constant-teacher ablation, an underpowered 'ideal' decoder giving a wrong erratum, V73's 0.055% correction, and gate counterexamples in the arithmetic audits (L11, L12).

skill_recommendations.name: lessons-as-regression-tests
skill_recommendations.rule: Every correction found by an audit (endpoint windows, estimability requirements, zero-variance handling, cohort labels, event order) is encoded as an executable regression test plus a frozen dictionary entry. New designs import endpoints and windows by ID and must pass all accumulated regression tests before implementation.
skill_recommendations.rationale: FB1 found a previously corrected forgetting window written wrong again and a lost 'all guards estimable' protection (L15). The V51 'untouched' cohort mislabel (L06) and the zero-variance interval (L05) are the same class.

skill_recommendations.name: claim-reproduction-ledger
skill_recommendations.rule: Every number taken from a proposal, review or summary must be re-derived from a named table (path, version, numerator, denominator) before it can motivate an arm or gate. Otherwise tag it UNVERIFIED. Proposals must declare the latest completed version they read; any proposal older than the current state is flagged stale.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Handoffs contained unit errors, pooled-bank ratios, misdefined features, wrong variable ranges, claims of execution without artifacts, '15 worse' that was really 7/8/0, and memos based on V70/V74 after newer results existed (L16).

skill_recommendations.name: generated-labels-and-banners
skill_recommendations.rule: Generate verdict labels, limit and scope strings and version IDs from the executed config and computed effects: the nonzero gene list, bounds, generations and histories, plus effect sign and interval. Forbid free-text templates. Quick, smoke, fixture, mock and engineering outputs carry a non-science banner in file name, title and first line, and their flags are suppressed. A report is incomplete without a written interpretation reconciled with its flags.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Stale 'four-coefficient/fixed anatomy' limits on a 17-gene anatomy-relaxing run, the V80E/V81E/V82E label drift, an allocation-only scope string on a stopped 17-gene run (L18), quick-run flags opposite to the full run, fixture Round-A reports without a banner (L21), and 'CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE' on harmful factors (L22).

skill_recommendations.name: unit-fact-registry
skill_recommendations.rule: Keep a machine-readable registry of verified unit facts (value, source path, hash, date, scope), e.g. alpha feedback about 1.37e-9, saturation at Q×2 or 10% sparsity, fast τ 3,488 s, NLMS 93% vs native 62.6% (sign metric). Every new proposal runs a fact-conflict check, and a premise contradicting a registered fact must cite the conflict.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The near-zero alpha feedback was rediscovered at least five times (L24) while proposals kept relying on alpha-feedback premises. Facts written into configs (V81E gene bounds) were carried forward correctly.

skill_recommendations.name: objective-distance-tracker
skill_recommendations.rule: Each design header states the highest contract evidence level its primary endpoint can reach and the number of consecutive rounds since the last test at the project's target level (E3 with prior-teaching causal control, raw bytes). After K rounds (e.g. 5) without a target-level test, the next design must include one or obtain explicit user acceptance of the gap.
skill_recommendations.rationale: About 30 versions (V55-V88) optimized E1 taught-association metrics on synthetic PN cues, each honestly scoped. Nothing tracked the cumulative distance from the byte/E3 objective until the 26-Sep contract (L25).

skill_recommendations.name: reference-qualification
skill_recommendations.rule: Before a model or dataset becomes a guardrail or gate target, check: prefix invariance (no future input); parameters at bounds or initial values; reconciliation of fitted data with final published tables; and the measurement convention. Unqualified references may be used only descriptively, with the defects listed in every score table.
skill_recommendations.rationale: The Huang batch model leaked future schedule information. 12/60 fit targets differed from the published tables, the slow lifetime sat at its bound, and the alpha gain sat at its initial value, yet these served as non-regression guardrails (L23).

skill_recommendations.name: champion-eligibility-and-amendment-disclosure
skill_recommendations.rule: Freeze a champion-eligibility rule. Refuse confirmation if the champion violates any development constraint or the feasible set contains only the reference, and report 'no feasible non-reference winner'. If an implementation amendment changes a primary cell's resolved or unresolved status, show the before and after dispositions in the headline and require fresh replication before reuse.
skill_recommendations.rationale: A nonzero champion was apparently confirmed from a 50-generation search with only one feasible individual (L19). V70's positive load-96 result exists only after post-launch solver amendments (L20).

skill_recommendations.name: artifact-preservation-before-cleanup
skill_recommendations.rule: No deletion or Trash of research artifacts without a prior verified manifest (path, size, SHA-256) and a readable archive copy confirmed by re-hash. Claims that rely on unrecoverable artifacts are tagged NOT_RECOVERED and cannot anchor designs.
skill_recommendations.rationale: Pre-V50 records were moved to Trash and later became inaccessible. The historical ELM P4 cell and iteration-6 checkpoints could not be recovered (L26).

readers.lens: Pre-Full151 archive (PRE_FULL151_DESIGNS_RESULTS_20261023, all eras): review, audit, correction and decision documents. Covers ELM-era V18–V49, MiniFly connectome/iteration line V50–V88, CORE_RECOVERY A2–A11/BKR/FB1, BYTE_CORE/BYTE_LEARNER/BYTE_ARITH, and the Full151 bridge up to the Package A/B V3 repair (6–30 Sep 2026). Recurrence was checked against post-Full151 repo folders and ROUTE_RETROSPECTIVE_20261014.
readers.summary:
Path convention: 'results/…' and 'designs/…' are relative to /home/user/digitalbaby/PROJECT_DOCUMENTS/PRE_FULL151_DESIGNS_RESULTS_20261023/. '(orig: …)' gives the CATALOG sources[0].relative folder. Some files were already in the consolidated tree; for those I cite the repo path.

What I did: I read every DECISION / FINAL_DECISION / NEXT_STEP_DECISION, every file named review / audit / corrected / erratum, the reviews/ folder, and the decision-bearing reports in each era. I ran nothing and changed nothing.

Main pattern. Most local experiments were frozen, gated and honestly reported. The serious failures came from five places:
1. Small code-level faults that silently disabled controls or scorers. A string mismatch 'rel' vs 'relation' made the E3 prior-teaching control do nothing. The change_truth 'commit vs onset' scoring defect was reintroduced three times, in new files. Validators accepted impossible values.
2. Gates that failed open.
3. Guards removed or reinterpreted after outcomes were known. The biggest case: the old-memory guards were demoted on 16–18 Sep. This happened before the 21 Sep start that the 14 Oct route retrospective gives for the first drift node, so the retrospective misses it.
4. Proxies or instruments standing in for the stated objective. On 22 Sep the owner fixed 'not blind memorization'; the instrument built that day was still beatable by an exact-key table.
5. Lessons and limitations not carried into the next design. V52's interface verdict, the read-order losses and the encode-once harness limit were all rediscovered later. The catalog dropped failed gates.

Evaluation of reviews. The reviews that changed a verdict were the ones that re-executed or recomputed from receipts with code independent of the runner:
- V39 gate re-analysis
- the A2 scoring replay
- the iteration-8 graph recomputation
- the A6 recomputation
- the V9.5 receipt re-audit
- the R2/Z1 literal-branch auditor
- the Claude A V3 replay audit

Design-level hostile audits mostly changed designs or stopped programs (FEAS v1→v6.1, FB1 v2→v3.1, BYTE_ARITH NO-GO). Review failed where:
- the auditor shared helpers with the runner
- the audit only checked that logs were self-consistent
- validators had no negative fixtures
- the implementer audited their own code
- a review claimed reruns that could not be verified

Decisions. ChatGPT, Claude and Codex wrote the designs and audits and recommended actions. Mr. Zhou made scope decisions: the byte-level and anti-memorization goals (22 Sep), a correction to the A2 control design, a preference for large samples (21 Sep), smaller one-hour questions (25 Sep), and later adoptions. Promotion rules were usually fixed before running and honored: V19, V43 Q0, A2, FEAS, BKR, FE1. The exceptions are listed in the findings.

findings.title: Silent string-key mismatch made the E3 prior-teaching control (N_old_rel) a no-op; the round was decided on an invalid control and a large native E3 signal was hidden
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The three-mechanism round reported 'Final withheld relation old-write effect difference' Z1 vs Z0 = +0.0 [+0.0,+0.0] and T2 +0.0 [+0.0,+0.0], and decided R2/Z1/T2=NO. A later correction design states the run 'was found to have a nonfunctional N_old_rel control'. The V3 repair notice gives the root cause: common_platform.branch_allows 'compared rel with relation', so N_old_rel and N_new_rel writes were never suppressed, and 'Previously committed V2 receipts ... their E3 contrasts are invalid' (this also covers Package B V2). The corrective rerun found native Z0 W−N = +38.0 points on held-out relations after a delay and an intervening cohort; Z1−Z0 = −14.6 [−27.3,−1.9]. INFERENCE: The zero-width intervals on a primary causal axis were visible symptoms, but the report did not flag them. The first auditor shared the runner's branch helper, so it could not see the fault. The broken control both voided the decision and masked the strongest native E3 effect in the archive.
evidence: results/815d1e7dc9bc5fdf_REPORT.md (orig: MINIFLY_THREE_MECHANISM_ROUND_20260928/results/REPORT.md) — Z1/T2 E3 contrasts +0.0 [+0.0,+0.0], decision NO

designs/3d468db9fadb30c3_DESIGN.md (orig: MINIFLY_R2_Z1_E3_CORRECTION_20260929/DESIGN.md) — 'nonfunctional N_old_rel control'; 'independent auditor uses a literal branch/domain matrix, not the runner's branch helper'
findings.how_detected: Post-run inspection; then a corrective experiment with an independent literal branch-matrix auditor and a deliberately restored V2 ledger that the auditor had to reject
findings.generic_safeguard: Each causal control branch must pass a liveness test before science: on a fixture where the control is known to matter, it must differ from W, and its write ledger must show zero writes in exactly its named domain. A zero-width interval on a primary contrast raises an integrity alarm, not a result. The auditor may not import runner helpers.
findings.recurs_later: Design-stage no-op controls appear earlier: bank-route shuffle as pure relabel (reviews/post_v5_full_low_designs, 21 Sep) and Q7 with a literal True flag (BYTE_CORE_1, 22 Sep). Post-Full151: inherited tamper fixtures could be no-ops on an empty cache (addition_observation_support_dev_v1_20261011/cycle_notes/CYCLE1_DESIGN.md:11).

findings.title: The 'change_truth is a commit, not the onset of information' scoring defect was reintroduced in new code three times within about two days
findings.description: DOCUMENT: A2 (19 Sep): exposures_at() counted exposures at or after the truth flip, so 140 of 160 legitimately taught revision facts were excluded. A claimed '+11.25 pp saved' was the defect itself. The 64-life confirmation size had been computed from this broken denominator, and corrected revision moved by up to −13.6 pp. Selectivity v1 (same day): '6/48 anchors used the opposite answer ... the same change_truth-is-a-commit-not-an-onset defect I had already found and fixed in the metrics extractor, reintroduced in a new file' (one of six audit findings). The full incoming set showed a mismatch in 24 windows, not 6. BKR V5 (20–21 Sep, found during CONF): the evaluator judged anomalies with the truth current at that time, so scheduled revisions were mislabeled SINGLE_ANOMALY. INFERENCE: The fix lived in one file, not in a shared semantic layer. Each new script re-derived event semantics.
evidence: results/86a1793ee7e8bed9_A2_FOLLOWUP_REPORT_20260919.md (orig: CORE_RECOVERY_workstreamA2/A2_FOLLOWUP_REPORT_20260919.md) §1 — revision contrasts shift up to −13.63 pp; n=64 plan superseded
findings.how_detected: Each time: an external scoring or code audit (ChatGPT/Codex) or a mid-run check, followed by an independent replay and offline rescore
findings.generic_safeguard: Put event semantics (delivered vs committed truth, exposure ledgers, populations) in one versioned, tested library. New scripts must import it. A regression fixture must place commit and onset at different times and assert that scores differ. A code review checklist item asks: which truth does this scorer use?
findings.recurs_later: Three times, 19–21 Sep. Not seen after BKR V5 in this archive, which suggests the replay-verified annotation fix plus independent reducers held.

findings.title: Matching a historical reference was mistaken for scorer validation (the anchor passed by coincidence)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: In canonical k=1 the flip ordinal equaled the probe's teach_index, so the strict test found no flip and the reference anchor scored 20/20 'by coincidence'. A1 revision 'did not move' for the same reason. A second case: the observer selected the 'last' probe by width ≥48, which picked the untrained-population diagnostic. It was right for k=1 'by luck' and wrong for k≥2 (clipping appeared to fall when it actually rises 53%). INFERENCE: Reproducing an archived number shows only that the edge case wasn't exercised in that fixture.
evidence: results/86a1793ee7e8bed9_A2_FOLLOWUP_REPORT_20260919.md §2 — final-clipping population inferred from array size
findings.how_detected: External scoring audit plus independent replay with role-aware ledgers
findings.generic_safeguard: Validate scorers on adversarial fixtures that would expose the defect (multi-cohort, shifted flips, several probe populations), not only on the anchor. Persist explicit population identity; never infer it from array width.
findings.recurs_later: Same family as F02 and F22. Post-Full151 reviews still note probe-population and roster omissions (e.g. Step 11 omitted the old-end held-out roster, results/7ca0708e2c15c2f5_REPORT.md).

findings.title: Fail-open gates and validators: missing, NaN or impossible values passed
findings.description: DOCUMENT: V43's reporting independent review (pre-freeze, about 10–11 Sep) found Q7 'not any(matches)' turned missing comparisons into a pass: 'an actual fail-open gate'. It also found that a positive firewall-check count proves only that one check ran. FULL v3 readiness (21 Sep): a missing or NaN guard must not auto-advance because comparing None yields no harm. BYTE_CORE_1 (22 Sep): 'Q7 ran on FE-ID and accuracy, with a literal True as the broken-variant flag — qualification did not test the designed claim'. V9.5 independent re-audit (26 Sep): the frozen validator accepted a choice of 2.0, a NaN scalar margin and an impossible [99,99,99] label. INFERENCE: The same class appears four times in two weeks, each found only by a separate reviewer.
findings.how_detected: Independent code review before source freeze (V43); hostile design audit (FULL v3); post-hoc erratum (BYTE_CORE_1); a separate reducer with synthetic corruptions (V9.5)
findings.generic_safeguard: Every gate returns PASS, FAIL or NOT_EVALUABLE. Missing, NaN or unsupported values map to NOT_EVALUABLE and block advancement. Every check ships with a broken variant that it must reject, and the rejection is archived. Validators range-check all derived fields before aggregation.
findings.recurs_later: Post-Full151: tamper fixtures were no-ops on an empty baseline (addition_observation_support_dev_v1_20261011/cycle_notes/CYCLE1_DESIGN.md:11).

findings.title: Zero empirical variance and zero-width intervals were read as certainty
findings.description: DOCUMENT: The RCE60 engineering run labels 'reduced_minus_full 0.0000 [0.0000,0.0000] Pass=True' on several rows (marked ENGINEERING_TEST_ONLY). The three-mechanism round shows +0.0 [+0.0,+0.0] as a decision input (F01). From 21 Sep the audits demand that 'all-zero observations cannot pass a [0,0] t interval as zero population risk'. A10 and BKR then emit 'zero empirical variance; unresolved without invariant' / INCONCLUSIVE_ZERO_VARIANCE. INFERENCE: The lesson took about a week to become standard. It held afterwards: 60 post-Full151 docs mention zero-variance handling.
findings.how_detected: Hostile design audits (Codex) and later the analysis code's own rules
findings.generic_safeguard: Zero variance on a contrast yields UNRESOLVED unless an exact invariant is proven. Escalate to an integrity check when the arms should differ by design.
findings.recurs_later: Partly stuck after 21 Sep. The 28 Sep three-mechanism case shows it can still hide a broken control.

findings.title: Absence of evidence used as evidence of safety: 'no confirmed harm', loose non-inferiority margins, 'CI includes 0.5 = absent'
findings.description: DOCUMENT: Earliest, V27 rec (7 Sep): 'a −5pp gate margin let a real −2.2pp loss read as no detectable loss'. Recurrences: V88 Round A (16 Sep) passed all NI margins although RCE_FULL had higher acquisition in 42 of 48 paired histories. Minimal-core v2 audit (21 Sep): a −6…+4 interval would satisfy 'no confirmed harm'. FB1 v3.1 audit (21 Sep): the rule let a candidate advance even with confirmed old-memory harm. FEAS v3/v4 reviews (23 Sep): adoption allowed a retention loss up to 0.02 (≈40–45% of FE0's η); 'H6 treated CI includes 0.5 as absence'; v5→v6: 'not confirmed' was turned into 'confirmed absent'. Catalog audit (28 Sep): 'No transfer, by construction' overstated a CI of −1.0 [−8.2,+6.1]. INFERENCE: This was the most persistent statistical-semantics failure. Repeated reviews kept catching it at design time, which shows the rule was never encoded once as a reusable rule.
evidence: designs/47e54dcf404ec57d_DESIGN_v4.md, designs/9536d71d82d5a273_DESIGN_v5.md, designs/d33e48faa1cd00b4_DESIGN_v6.md (orig: BYTE_CORE_FEAS_1_20260923/) review-response tables
findings.how_detected: Re-reading design text plus small statistical calculations in hostile audits
findings.generic_safeguard: Status for every protection quantity is POS, NEG or UNRESOLVED. Promotion requires a justified non-inferiority margin, stated relative to the baseline effect size. 'No confirmed harm' never earns a safe or adoptable label. Report the count of units that lose, not only the mean.
findings.recurs_later: Repeated 7, 16, 21, 23 and 28 Sep. Post-Full151 critiques still warn against lowering gates (arithmetic_feedback_rule_discovery_dev_v1_20261013/ops/read_only_review_20261013/design_critic/CRITIQUE.md:46).

findings.title: Post-hoc gate repair and reinterpretation of a peer's failed gates (V39/V40)
findings.description: DOCUMENT: Claude's V39 REPORT verdict 'no_capacity_pressure' (G2 FAIL, 'No valid arm at both load extremes') became REPORT_CORRECTED verdict 'qualified' (G2 and G3 pass). The V40 rec explains the G2 arm-selection bug (PRED-V slot arms run only at low loads), 'corrected in reanalyse_v39.py without rerunning trajectories'. It explicitly leaves G3 'as preregistered; changing it after seeing data would be post-hoc selection'. The same document reinterprets ChatGPT's preregistered Q12/Q13 failures (V39 SUMMARY 'Scientific qualification: NOT ESTABLISHED') as 'threshold strictness, not mechanism ... understates its own result'. It also introduces a new composite 'wall' metric after both runs. INFERENCE: The bug fix was disclosed and is defensible. The asymmetry (repair your own gate, soften a peer's failure) and the outcome-defined composite endpoint are the earliest instance of post-outcome reframing.
evidence: results/001dceec7ee77047_REPORT.md vs results/45124a4d4773b8ba_REPORT_CORRECTED.md (orig: v39_results/REPORT.md, v39_results/REPORT_CORRECTED.md) — diff only in G2/G3 status and verdict
results/928d967cb67a74e0_SUMMARY.md (orig: elm_v39_science/SUMMARY.md) — Q12/Q13 fail, NOT ESTABLISHED
findings.how_detected: Self-reanalysis by the implementing agent (re-execution of gate code on saved trajectories)
findings.generic_safeguard: Gate-code corrections after unblinding go into a separately labeled CORRECTED artifact with a diff, a bug fixture showing the original was wrong independent of outcome, and an independent second agent's sign-off. Reinterpreting any preregistered failure (own or peer's) requires the same procedure, and the original verdict stays the headline.
findings.recurs_later: V88 gate removal (F08), the CORE_RECOVERY re-tally (F09), the FE0+0.02×CONTENT weight chosen after data (28 Sep stage-exit decision), and post-Full151 warnings.

findings.title: Objective re-scope that removed the only failing guard: V88 demoted collateral/unrelated retention after the trace-restored candidate failed it
findings.description: DOCUMENT: V88 (16 Sep) says the trace-restored RCE candidate 'was rejected solely by the collateral_survival reduction gate', and that 'unrelated-memory retention ... is not a primary objective'. Its hostile-audit table marks 'Unrelated-memory retention accidentally acts as a hard persistence objective → Removed from Round A gate; retained only diagnostically: RESOLVED'. Non-objectives now include 'retention of every currently valid but behaviorally unused association'. Round A then passed on 48 histories. INFERENCE: The audit table endorsed the gate removal rather than challenging it. I found no document recording that the owner approved this redefinition. This is the earliest drift node away from 'OLD knowledge protected', the objective now in force.
findings.how_detected: Not flagged as drift at the time. Inferred here by comparing with MINIFLY_OBJECTIVE_CONTRACT and the route retrospective
findings.generic_safeguard: Demoting or removing any preregistered guard after outcomes requires explicit owner approval in the project log, a new namespace, and a confirmation on fresh worlds that reports exactly the harm the removed guard measured as a co-primary.
findings.recurs_later: Directly feeds F09. The route retrospective (14 Oct) places the first drift node, A01, at 21 Sep and does not register this 16 Sep re-scope.

findings.title: CORE_RECOVERY re-analysis deleted 12 blanket old-memory gates post hoc to reopen CONTRACT_0.05 and C_FORGET; later confirmation showed exactly the guarded harms
findings.description: DOCUMENT: On 18 Sep Claude re-scored archived OMNIBUS10/V74 on competence endpoints. 'Re-tallying development_gates.csv with the twelve old-memory gates removed' made CONTRACT_0.05 the 'only arm of ten' passing, and C_FORGET was reopened ('bridge premise confirmed'). The document asserts this 'is not post-hoc cherry-picking'. Later confirmation of R (the contraction) in BKR V5: BR vs B first return −9.11 [−15.25,−2.98] canonical; K8 current usefulness −9.49; K8 7-day −8.04. The A9 audit notes Stage 3B contraction first-use return −7.81 [−12.39,−3.24] and says 'TRANSFER_UNRESOLVED ≠ no negative evidence'. INFERENCE: The guards removed after the fact predicted the later confirmed harm. Reopening the candidate cost confirmation compute and nudged the line toward relevance-only competence. The re-analysis itself was technically careful: it reproduced the original analysis to 1e-16 first.
evidence: results/56b68842253f2a9a_REPORT.md (orig: DESIGN_AUDIT_A9_TOURNAMENT_20260920/REPORT.md) §3 'C 已有明确的收益和负向效应'
findings.how_detected: Not challenged at the time. The harms surfaced in the preregistered BKR V5 confirmation and the A9 design audit
