Claims that held: the E01 diff and preregistered G2 text; V40 §1.4; the V40 wall table; three-mechanism zero-variance arms; the rel/relation notice; the V88 collateral lines and 42/48; the V84E/V85E/V80E/V82E decision.json files and V87's premise; the V23 retrieval-arm identity; the FB1-followup fixture title and sign; the V9.5 validator and rest correction; A2 change_truth; selectivity 'reintroduced'; the CORE_RECOVERY gate counts (twelve removed, nine failed); BKR V5 R harms, with R = CONTRACT_0.05; V51 ADOPT; the V52 untouched correction; the V41 lookahead; V47's next branch and V48/V49 having no V47 references; BYTE_CORE_1 δ = 0.02 vs η = 0.0047; the FEAS draft errata; V83 continuous life; V75 joint expression; the OMNIBUS10 sign convention; the V20 review; the V26 closure claims; the missing drift audit; the CATALOG splits.

CORRECTIONS:
(1) T06: R2 also differs between W and N_old_rel (sd 0.147), not only Rrand. n_worlds is 32.
(2) L19: feasible = 1 in 46 of 50 generations, not all 50, and the best score was not fixed. The 'infeasible champion' claim is unverified.
(3) E03: HYBRID-FROZEN was a designed diagnostic with only a partial freeze (V40 rec line 195), not an unplanned stop-learning control.
(4) E07: the FB1 v3.2 fixture FINAL_DECISION has a distinct catalog title and banner; only the FB1-followup fixture shares an identical title.
(5) F08: the retrospective excluded the pre-21 Sep nodes by its evidentiary standard (line 23), and its cited (missing) drift audit is named V88_TO_V9_7.
(6) E10/T07: FB1's ADVANCE_AS_RESOURCE_CANDIDATE with STABLE_RISK_UNRESOLVED followed the v3.1 audit's own recommendation and stated scope.
(7) E01/F07: the V39 correction is a mix of a genuine arm-selection bug fix and an endpoint/load re-specification.
Lesson: reader-level synthesis overstated claims made from partial reads in about a fifth of the checked items. A verify pass on primary files is necessary before skills are built on incidents.
decision_making_patterns: Division of roles. Doc, across eras: Claude (often) wrote recommendations and some implementations. ChatGPT/Codex locked protocols, implemented, audited uploaded code, and wrote the Chinese hostile audits. Mr. Zhou set scope and preferences: byte-level work and 'not blind memorization' (22 Sep, ARCH/designs/2a54ffdef3862514_DESIGN.md §0); large samples but no experiments of 1,500+ trajectories (21 Sep); smaller 'one-hour' questions (25 Sep, ARCH/designs/f1c9888ad1fbb00d C2); later adoptions. Inference: agents made most go/no-go calls. Owner decisions behind several pivots (V47 -> V48 raw-BANC, ELM -> native, V88's non-objective) are not recorded, which makes authorized redirection hard to tell apart from drift.

Inside an experiment, preregistered rules were mostly honored even when unfavorable. Examples: V19 stop rule; V41/V43 'gates remain visible as failed'; V43 Q0 not relaxed; A2's falsifiable b_slow prediction rejected; FEAS NO_CANDIDATE_SELECTED; BKR frozen selection; the FB1-followup launch gate stopped on storage (3.87x over) rather than deleting evidence (ARCH/results/bf31ac71de591391_LAUNCH_GATE_REPORT.md); FE1 NO_DEMONSTRATED_INCREMENT; R2/Z1 never overwrote old receipts. Decisions went wrong between experiments: in recommendation documents, re-analyses, summaries and next-design premises (FC03, FC04, FC12, FC14).

Post-outcome reframing clusters in recommendation and re-analysis documents written by the agent with a stake in the reframing. V27 'underpowered, not wrong'; V39/V40 own-gate repair plus peer-failure softening; V88 objective narrowing; the CORE_RECOVERY gate re-tally. FEAS v4 and later introduced an AWAITING_OWNER status for non-clean outcomes, which is the right routing pattern.

Corrections were real and frequent but were placed in the NEXT document ('Corrections to my own earlier claims', 'Corrections to Claude') rather than as errata attached to the corrected report. Some late corrections were in-place prose clarifications without a separate erratum hash (Output Step 2, FE1). Inference: this placement is the mechanism by which corrections were lost.

External inputs were treated as hypotheses, not instructions. Examples: 'a proposal, not an instruction source' (iterations 6-24); '没有把最新 markdown 中的执行指令当作用户启动授权' (the execution instructions in the latest markdown were not treated as the user's launch authorization; FB1 audit); 'treated as hypotheses to check' (A6, MATHEMATICAL_INPUT_REVIEW). This blocked handoff errors and reward-like progress scores. The one cost was under-delivery: the V79 scope filter dropped part of the user's explicit request.

Breadth over depth. Compute was cheap (minutes per campaign), so 30+ versions ran in about 4 days in mid-September, with long same-day revision chains (FEAS v1 -> v6.1). Inference, shared by reader 3: the binding constraint was interpretive capacity and objective tracking, not compute. Self-improvement skills should spend effort on cross-round accounting rather than on more runs.

Evidence storage was optimized for small bundles (<10 MB, 64/256 MiB caps). This repeatedly conflicted with offline rescoring and per-record causal audits (summary-only A2 pilot; terminal-only hashes in A9; missing per-input bitmaps in FB1-followup; aggregate-only write ledgers in Package B), and was settled case by case.

Destructive cleanup came before verified archiving. Pre-V50 records were moved to Trash on 21 Sep, and recovery was later impossible (ARCH/results/b0f8023e80dc6cc6_TRASH_API_RESULT.txt; ARCH/README.md 'Recovery and access limits'). Key governance documents are referenced but absent, notably V88_TO_V9_7_OBJECTIVE_DRIFT_AUDIT_20260926.md, which is cited by the objective contract and the retrospective. Decisions grounded in them cannot be audited.

Staged validity-first gating (P0/G0/Q0: 'a failure voids the levels beneath it') was adopted early (V27 headroom, V31 P0, V39 G0-G2, V43 Q0). It works only when the validity gate covers CURRENT acquisition and the executed configuration. V39/V40's G0 checked only wave-A acquisition (FC06).

Unattended-run pattern from iteration 19 onward: STATUS = COMPLETED_REPORT_PENDING, atomic receipts, verified resume, and an interpretation written later. This separated execution from interpretation, but late reports became thin templates with flags and no interpretation (V83-V88).
unit_facts: Path convention: ARCH = /home/user/digitalbaby/PROJECT_DOCUMENTS/PRE_FULL151_DESIGNS_RESULTS_20261023. 'Doc' means the cited report states it. ELM era, from the V20 review (6 Sep; ARCH/results/67d35b7d1fa5f061_v20_results_review.md <- v20_results_review.md). Normalized local delta writes on overlapping sparse features learn and revise quickly but overwrite unrelated old associations; cumulative ridge retains but under-revises. An output-port gain controller cannot change the overlap factor, and random 104-port codes give C C^T = 104 I, so code dimension sets the update scale. V49 had to re-derive this with a sqrt(104) standardization.

Doc, V28 (ARCH/designs/9a09a44b5e7f7c29_v28_experiment_recommendation.md §3). A valid retention or compatibility task needs four things: recall probes on the same trained identities (not fresh latents), arbitrary bindings, measured headroom for the encoder actually used, and no replay. Otherwise a 'Pareto' verdict measures rule generalization. Doc, V31: encoder adequacy (P0) on the actual stream must be shown before mechanism tests (MECHANISM_SCREEN_20261007/VERSION_REGISTER_20261011/sources/09_REPORT.md).

Doc, V32-V35. An exact-context dictionary keeps 100% retention with 0% revision. Shared parametric writers keep 2-22% untouched retention after three waves. A cumulative RLS solver rescues retention (about 95%) at the cost of current learning and revision. Whole-stream bpb can be best while target bpb is worst, since the target is 1 of 14 bytes (ARCH/results/ee65f7fb24fc5b00_SUMMARY.md, e1eab09edf596959, 9c79f0f7a3880a2a, 5cddb9746ab60b7d).

Doc, V35/V36. An additive residual over a drifting shared base fails even with exact private storage (LOCAL-R 29.7% vs LOCAL-V 99.2%), and freezing the base restores it (100%) (ARCH/results/5cddb9746ab60b7d_SUMMARY.md, b63f0b2e0ea9f59a_SUMMARY.md).

Doc, V39/V40. Retention tracks different-key code overlap, and one-shot transfer tracks same-key overlap. Hash or exact addressing is the retention corner with zero transfer (V39 G4: retention 1.000, held-out 0.000). Code stationarity dominated separation ratio, with caveats: phase arms had a historical lookahead (FC07), and 'transfer' there is E2 surface overlap (10 of 12 shared context bytes). Sources: ARCH/results/001dceec7ee77047_REPORT.md; ARCH/designs/bf66d97e7165c883; ARCH/designs/38de31ee6e5f3341 §3.2.

Doc, V43 (ARCH/results/d7d7cdefe31c1cc3_v43_analysis_report.md). Under fixed slot capacity, old recall can stay about 99% while new-cohort acquisition collapses (mature-slot pressure), so old-memory probes alone do not show continued learning. A win frequency of 55.46% coexisted with a much worse pooled loss (5.675 vs 3.649 bits per G event), so aggregation choice decides the verdict.

Doc, V45-V47. Learning positive invariance in one shared matrix raises useful sharing and harmful different-outcome cross-talk together, and learned downstream routing made the interference worse (reader E-lens; V45/V46 summaries and the V46/V47 designs).

Doc, MiniFly iterations 4-23 (13-14 Sep). (a) Hidden state matters: equal current alpha3 output (5.839 Hz) diverges to 14.741 vs 5.916 Hz after 24 h depending on the fast/slow split (iteration4, ARCH/results/ea94e0b83866bd66). (b) Probes are interventions: snapshot 65.7% vs serial 61.0% (iteration9, 209dccccdefe7689). (c) Interference is set by the signed direction of later writes on shared slow coordinates: held-out R^2 0.783 vs 0.002 for aggregate magnitude (iteration11/12, 15e2cd829a3fdaa2, fc28bebbc450be3a). (d) Decodability is not controllability: AUROC 0.951, yet a gate built on it selects wrong-direction writes and costs −26.6 pp (iteration13, a980e90d0c5d9388). (e) Immediate revision is not durable: 7/7 -> 0/7 next day; durable revision rises with dose at measurable old-margin cost (iterations 9/19/20). (f) Output saturation hides stored distinctions (iteration 19, e9474fbf5693ba4e). (g) In the fitted model, alpha MBON->DAN feedback is about 1.37e-9, at its fitting initialisation, so alpha-route interventions are near-null by construction.

Doc, byte line V52-V54 (12 Sep). Writing at every byte destroys associations, while evaluator-gated target-only writing works but is a non-deployable oracle; knowing where and when to write is the bottleneck. Raw position match proposes same-identity pairs with AUC 0.996 and precision 0.82, vs KC Jaccard precision 0.09 (ARCH/results/589de53c61e50eb3_SUMMARY.md; f7a94b1670c94ed0_SUMMARY.md).

Doc, evolution V79E-V86 (14-16 Sep). Champions selected on branched clone panels are at most equal to REF in an uninterrupted life by load 168: REF 0.549, V84E 0.546, V82 0.421, V85E 0.448 (ARCH/results/e7fb66911e1257b4_REPORT.md). Every evolution confirmation failed: V80E 20/77, V82E 27/77, V84E 28/77, V85E 47/77 (SPOT-CHECKED decision.json files).

Doc, PN-world CORE_RECOVERY (19-21 Sep). FULL_151 (genome id 151ebd9e..., not 151 neurons) is a one-bit valence learner: one alpha3 compartment, 5,177 KCs, slow tau about 142.6 days, fast tau about 56 minutes. Sharing state with other cohorts' learning costs 15-24 pp at matched target timing; a stretched schedule costs about 0; an aged learner acquires a fresh cohort 7.44 pp better. The slow store carries 23.70 of the 24.13 pp rescue. Selectivity headroom exists at bout scale (+5.6 to +6.8 pp) but the needed signal is not locally observable (ARCH/results/86a1793ee7e8bed9, a68efbbadeeae6f8, 618535acd0e9de8e; ARCH/designs/2a54ffdef3862514 §1).

Doc, A8/A9/BKR V5 and V9.6 (20-25 Sep). The fixed label-free B baseline transfer helps PN-world competence (+1.83 to +6.24 pp; it beat four stratified shuffles) but does not transfer to bytes (V9.6 −1.25 pp). Adding the CONTRACT_0.05 contraction (R) gives confirmed first-return and long-horizon losses (BR canonical first return −9.11; K8 −9.49/−8.04). Sources: ARCH/results/481026f1a3aee6f2, 4cd35860ea6df529, f8a26f815ea83f5a.

Doc, routing and banks (21-25 Sep). Adaptive routing hurt compared with fixed routing (S_LOCAL − S_FIXED = −19.05 pp). A fixed hash beat geometric routing at 8 banks for exact-repeat first return (−6.02 [−7.69, −4.36] pp). Extra banks raise absolute old and new choice mainly through a birth advantage without reducing incremental write harm (V9.6 DiD +0.42 [−6.10, +6.93]; V9.7 HASH8 DiD −11.20 pp). Sources: ARCH/results/9f4cef7ec335306e, 428a50a89005dc77, f8a26f815ea83f5a, 008d8788aee0284b.

Doc, byte interface (22-26 Sep). FULL_151 with FE0 learns near the floor on F3 bytes (eta 0.0047 vs FE-ID oracle 0.2557). FE0 keeps the last byte (0.87) but loses the one before (0.22). A latency-class LAT4 front end keeps order (1.00) and passed the ORDER gate in 3 of 3 worlds. 128-bin pooling collapses the native arm. Four learned byte cohorts leave a persistent −11.33 pp old-choice cost (123 of 563 pairs lost vs 3 without writes). The narrowing after rest is the no-write arm losing its advantage. Sources: ARCH/results/0f945a19e8cfb86c, c69e155a7baa1dcf, 2fb597f44858e907, 802e79d1c8cfe876, 6a9f765adc858339.

Doc, native E3 (26-29 Sep). It is real but narrow. V9.9A +17.19 pp (class), V9.9B +9.57 pp (rank), both at or below one-bit-per-symbol ceilings. Extra writes help taught pairs (+9.69) far more than held-out pairs (+1.76). Native taught-edge margins hold more relational information than the native readout uses (external potential 76.17% vs 60.74%). An online shared 5,177-weight KC head reaches 77.54% on rank (scalar-solvable), retained at 75.39%, but 51.0% on a cyclic family; that failure is inductive bias, not representation. With a working control, Z0 W−N is +38.0 pp on 32 worlds (one-bit solvable). Sources: minifly_b/package/DOCS/BYTE_CORE_V9_9A/REPORT.md, BYTE_CORE_V9_9B_RANK/REPORT.md; ARCH/results/dc06f516f2f5bae2, 711351597327d471, cfe49b4f76eb5442, 7237c8e92dc9bcb8, 79eb1e61f8099fb4, 994af59f25e9acb0.

Doc, separated or exact addressing across three lineages. ELM V39 HASH-O; native V9.7/V9.8 HASH8 (E3 −8.3/−19.4 pp on 12 worlds); Full151 bridge H4 (shifted-key access 24.3%), fading pairs (held-out −6.25 vs FE0 +21.88), CONTENT (E1 512/512 and −0.78 pp at 32 keys, but E3 −1.0 vs FE0 +17.2). All raise taught recall (E1) and abolish held-out relation reuse (E3). This is the most re-derived unit fact in the archive.

Doc, arithmetic feasibility (26 Sep, ARCH/results/9b9736c166bf5550_REPORT.md, 26c74d446d907733_REPORT.md, 34316d5e7fb50272_REPORT.md). A fully supervised raw-byte GRU with 512 answers reaches only 5.5-10.9% exact on unseen one-operator expressions. Native punishment through hashed action contacts lacks reliable direction (5 of 32 cases favoured the selected answer). V2 evolution learned 1.3% vs a no-write arm at 7.7%.

Doc, harness constraint (19-28 Sep). The V88-lineage evaluate_life encodes world['pn'] once per life, so it has no changed-rendering data and cannot test E2. Dynamic input plasticity is invisible unless the encoding path is replaced (ARCH/results/07e62861f41ae86c_REPORT.md §3; 2019838ad1e8d5fe §5).

Doc, next-byte addresses (27 Sep). A next-byte prediction distribution used as a memory address collapses when all cues share the following byte (pairwise L1 0.818 -> 0.129, W−N +25 -> 0 pp). Stable feature identities avoid the collapse but are brittle to shifts. At equal write dose, the identity of competing cue strings decides survival (16/16 vs 1/16). Sources: ARCH/results/22b98b675d8643fa, fbf1732a64eb40e9, a6918b9812f5b9ac, 162fd85a5ad75dfc.
top_lessons_for_skills: Lessons must become executable artifacts, not prose. Every failure class here recurred because its fix lived in one file or one document. Turn each audit finding into (a) a regression test or fixture that every new runner must pass and (b) an entry in an inherited-findings ledger that every new design must import and mark RESOLVED, OPEN or ACCEPTED (FC08, FC12; earliest 7 Sep V26 audit loss; the zero-variance rule was lost within 7 days).

Control-liveness before interpretation. No causal contrast is interpretable until its control has passed four checks: (1) a literal per-branch write matrix built from an independent table; (2) a planted-defect mutation test that must be rejected; (3) a positive-control fixture with nonzero W−N; (4) a not-identical-to-parent detector. Any zero-width interval or bit-identical arm on a primary contrast is INTEGRITY_ALARM, never a null (FC01, FC02; V20/V23 on 6 Sep to the three-mechanism round on 28 Sep).

Degenerate-learner panel for every promotion gate. Before freezing, score stop-learning, frozen-layer, exact-key, canonical-key, hash, mode, one-bit class, scalar potential, constant and cross-record-leak learners against the gate. If any passes, cap the claim at that E-level. Pair every retention endpoint with a current-acquisition gate, and put any diagnostic arm that beats the candidate in the headline. This is the main defence against specification gaming (FC06; V40 HYBRID-FROZEN wall 1.000, BYTE_ARITH countermodel +11.2 pp).

Separate the judge from the optimized object. Hash every scoring-path array and require equality across arms. Confirm in a deployment-parity panel (an uninterrupted life with experienced delays), not on clone-branched diagnostics (FC06; V81E/V82E observer coupling, V83/V86 champions worse than REF).

Verdicts are append-only. A post-outcome change to gate code, arm, endpoint, loads, threshold or seeds requires an erratum file attached to the original, with the old and new verdict, a diff, BUG_FIX or POST_HOC classification and an independent sign-off. POST_HOC never upgrades a verdict, index titles must differ, and downstream documents cite the erratum ID. Apply the same standard to your own and peer failures. Failed gates are final; follow-ups use fresh seeds and a new preregistration (FC03; V39 REPORT_CORRECTED, V27/V39/V40 reinterpretations, CORE_RECOVERY gate re-tally).

Objective and standing-constraint ledger with diff. Each design restates the canonical contract objective and E-level verbatim and lists constraints as RETAINED, RELAXED (with a dated owner quote) or NEW, and a tool diffs this against the contract and the predecessor. A gate that has rejected a candidate cannot be demoted to 'not an objective' without an owner-signed OBJECTIVE_CHANGE, and it stays a co-primary. Track rounds since the last target-level (E3) test, and force one after K rounds (FC04; V47 -> V48 pivot, V88 collateral removal, about 30 E1-only MiniFly versions).

Evidence-level tagging everywhere, with generated labels. Every endpoint, sentence and summary row carries an E0-E4 tag, its metric definition and denominator, its preregistered verdict, and any post-hoc flag, pulled from machine-readable decision files. Words like 'core', 'established', 'generalization', 'validated', 'adopted' and 'solved' are generated only when the contract level is met. For E2 probes, check that variant and canonical inputs have different internal addresses (FC05, FC15, FC16; V50, V75, OMNIBUS10, CONTENT E2).

Guard power precheck. Compute minimum detectable effect, half-width, floor and ceiling at the planned n before science. A guard that cannot fail is NOT_ASSESSABLE and cannot license advancement. Materiality must be smaller than the plausible effect. 'No confirmed harm', 'not confirmed' and 'CI includes chance' never become 'safe' or 'absent'. Report the count of units that lost (FC10; V27 −5 pp margin, BYTE_CORE_1 δ > η, FB1 ±38 pp, V88 42/48).

Adoption requires a pass. Before citing any prior candidate as working, anchor, default or validated, load its decision file and quote its status. Use SCREENED -> CONFIRMED -> TRANSFERRED status. A capability claim names one frozen configuration that passed all named tasks in the same trial, with an attribution ledger (native-route lesion, resource ratio) (FC14; V84E 28/77 -> 'works'; V27 contrast default; V9.2 engineered predictor at 17.4x).

Cross-lineage unit-fact and capability-baseline registry. Store negative facts (exact or hash addressing gives E1 but no E3; alpha feedback about 1e-9; FE0 loses byte order; encode-once harness) and positive baselines (native E3 V9.9A/B, V9.10C, Z0 +38 pp, all one-bit-scoped). Every design runs a conflict query and compares against the baselines on the same assay (FC13; the hash fact was re-derived across three lineages, alpha feedback five times).

Causal-time firewall. Run a future-mutation test, a read-purity digest test, a zero-old-training-after-transition assertion and a first-presentation AUC at chance for every learner, calibration and probe. 'Label-free' is not 'causal' (FC07; V26 shift stream, V39 PhaseFront, the Huang source model, FE-NI read(), the BYTE_CORE_1 cross-record leak).

Single imported semantics library for truth, exposure, cohort and population. Cohorts are derived by set algebra from the generator with disjointness and size tests. Validation anchors must exercise the edge case (FC08; change_truth reintroduced three times; V51 'untouched' = revised + noisy).

Realized-quantity matching and absolute-vs-incremental decomposition. Matched controls declare the realized quantity and tolerance from logs. Protection claims report absolute, prechallenge and own-state W−N DiD, and decompose any narrowing contrast by arm (FC09; V54-V69 dose chain, V9.6 birth advantage, V9.5 'rest recovery').

Audit independence levels. L0 re-read, L1 recompute with separate code, L2 independent-implementation replay, L3 tamper battery including self-consistent joint tampering. Promotion and E3 claims require L2 or higher, and implementer-only audits are labelled and cannot promote. The auditor never imports runner helpers (the review practices that changed verdicts vs failed).

Claim-reproduction ledger for cross-agent inputs. Re-derive every cited number from a named table or tag it UNVERIFIED. Strip numeric progress scores. Flag stale proposals. Tag QA with an execution level. Echo back any narrowing of the user's explicit request (FC19).

Feasibility and value of information before expensive runs. Require a privileged positive control that reaches the gate, a feasibility witness for absolute thresholds, fitness repeatability before evolutionary search, disjoint pilot and confirmation rosters, and a churn bound on protocol revisions (FC18; V36 gate, 3,072 floor lives, BYTE_ARITH V2, FEAS v1 -> v6.1, A11 v3.8).

Lineage-complete reading for any archive analysis or summarization skill. Group design -> run -> report -> audit -> erratum -> next recommendation by folder and date, never by regex over version tokens or catalog era, and quarantine fixtures by namespace and kind. Verify reader-level claims against primary files before encoding them in skills: about a fifth of the checked reader claims in this merge needed correction (FC15; CATALOG splits; FB1-followup fixture with opposite sign and identical title).

Provenance before execution. Commit designs (including chat-derived ones), runner source, environment lock and raw per-record primitives sufficient for offline rescoring before science. Assert executed hash = locked hash. No destructive cleanup without a manifest. Check in CI that every referenced governance document exists. The V88_TO_V9_7 drift audit, which the contract relies on, is missing (FC17, decision patterns).
